title: South Korea, Ukraine relations sour over North Korean POW transfer
english: Diplomatic tensions have risen between South Korea and Ukraine after Kyiv publicly revealed the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war. Seoul claims there was a formal confidentiality agreement to protect the soldiers' safety, which Ukraine allegedly violated and subsequently denied existed. The South Korean government has expressed strong regret over the incident, stating that this breach of trust negatively impacts the relationship between the two nations.

Mootummaan Kooriyaa Kibbaa, nageenya hidhattoota kanaa eeguuf jecha Ukreen waliin walii galtee icitii akka qaban ibsee, Ukreen garuu walii galtee kana cabsuu fi jiraachuu isaa takkaa akka mormite himata. title: ‘Iran ready for doomsday war’, FM Araghchi says
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has declared that his country is prepared for a major conflict, even a catastrophic war, following the rejection of its proposal to end hostilities. Despite this stance, the minister indicated that Iran is still interested in pursuing diplomatic solutions. This development follows US President Donald Trump's decision to turn down Iran’s offer to stop the fighting and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchiin, biyyi isaanii waraana guddaa fi hamaa keessatti hirmaachuuf qophiidha jedhaniiru. Ta'us, mootummaan Iraan ammallee marii dippiloomaasiitiif fedhii akka qabu ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun kan dhufe, pirezidaantiin Amerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp, Iraan waraana dhaabuufi daandii bishaan Hormuz banuuf guyyaa torbaaf dhiheessite qorannoo malee erga dide booda.

title: Mike Waltz: US offered to sell Iran uranium for civilian programme
english: US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz revealed that the Trump administration previously offered to supply Iran with uranium for peaceful civilian energy use. Iran rejected the proposal, which was intended to mirror the model used by the UAE to ensure nuclear compliance. The US remains open to supporting a civilian nuclear program for Iran provided the country adheres to international laws and agrees to surrender its current stockpiles of enriched material.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተባበሩት መንግስታት አምባሳደር ማይክ ዋልትዝ እንደገለጹት፣ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ኢራን ለሰላማዊ የኃይል ማመንጫ አገልግሎት የምትጠቀምበት ዩራኒየም ለማቅረብ አቅርቦት አቅርቦ ነበር። ኢራን ይህንን ጥያቄ ውድቅ ያደረገች ሲሆን፣ አሜሪካ ይህንን ስምምነት በተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች ሞዴል መሰረት ለመተግበር አቅዳ ነበር። አሜሪካ ኢራን ዓለም አቀፍ ህጎችን የምትከተል ከሆነ እና ያላትን የዩራኒየም ክምችት የምትለቅ ከሆነ ለሰላማዊ የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራም ያላትን ድጋፍ ለመቀጠል ፍቃደኛ ነች።
oromo: Ambaasaddarri Ameerikaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti, Maayik Waaltz, mootummaan Doonaald Tiraamp kanaan dura Iraaniif sagantaa humna elektirikii nagaa fayyadamuuf uraniyemii gurguruuf dhiyeessii dhiyeessee akka ture ibsaniiru. Iraan dhiyeessii kana kan dide yoo ta'u, Ameerikaan yaada kana kan maddisiifte akkaataa biyyi UAE itti fayyadamtuun akka fakkeenyaatti fudhachuun ture. Ameerikaan, Iraan seera idil-addunyaa kan kabajju fi uraniyemii qabdu kan gadi dhiistu taanaan, sagantaa nukileraa nagaaf deggarsa kennuuf fedhii qabaachuu ishee ibsiteetti.

title: One month after Nepal’s catastrophic floods, thousands remain missing
english: A month after devastating floods in Nepal, over 5,000 people are still unaccounted for and many remain in temporary shelters. Ongoing rainfall is complicating the situation for displaced families, creating further hardship. The nation now faces an enormous financial challenge, with reconstruction costs estimated at nearly five billion dollars.
amharic: በኔፓል የደረሰው አሰቃቂ የጎርፍ አደጋ ከተከሰተ አንድ ወር ቢያልፍም ከ5,000 በላይ ሰዎች አሁንም የት እንዳሉ አይታወቅም። በጊዜያዊ መጠለያ የሚገኙ ተፈናቃዮች አዲስ ዝናብ በመጣሉ ለከፍተኛ ችግር ተጋልጠዋል። አገሪቱ ከጉዳቱ ለማገገም ወደ አምስት ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚጠጋ ከፍተኛ ወጪ እንደሚጠይቅ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Nepaaliitti lolaa hamaa erga mudatee ji'a tokko booda, namoonni 5,000 ol ta'an ammallee bakka bu'een isaanii hin beekamu. Roobni har'a roobee jiru mana jireenyaa yeroo keessa jiraatan irratti rakkoo dabalataa uumee jira. Biyyi kun deebisanii ijaaruuf qarshii biliyoona shan gahu gargaarsa barbaada.

title: Giant pandas arrive in Atlanta as part of 10-year US-China agreement
english: Two giant pandas named Ping Ping and Fu Shuang have arrived at Zoo Atlanta following a new 10-year loan agreement between the United States and China. This move is seen as a diplomatic effort to improve relations between the two nations after a recent high-level summit. The zoo has prepared specialized habitats and food supplies to ensure the pandas transition smoothly into their new home.
amharic: ፒንግ ፒንግ እና ፉ ሹአንግ የተባሉ ሁለት ግዙፍ ፓንዳዎች በአሜሪካ እና በቻይና መካከል በተደረገ የአስር ዓመት ስምምነት መሰረት አትላንታ መካነ አራዊት ገብተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው ከፍተኛ የሁለቱ ሀገራት መሪዎች ውይይት በኋላ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር እንደ ምልክት ይታያል። መካነ አራዊቱ ፓንዳዎቹ በአዲሱ አካባቢያቸው በቀላሉ እንዲላመዱ ልዩ መኖሪያዎችን እና የምግብ አቅርቦቶችን አዘጋጅቷል።
oromo: Pandawwan gurguddoon lama, Ping Ping fi Fu Shuang jedhaman, waliigaltee waggaa kudhanii kan Ameerikaa fi Chaayinaa gidduutti mallattaayeen gara Zoo Atlanta ga'aniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii fooyyessuuf akka mallattoo dippilomaasummaatti ilaalama. Zoo-n sun pandawwan kunneen bakka haaraa isaanii keessatti haala gaariin akka wajjin qabatanuf, bakka jireenyaa addaa fi nyaata barbaachisu qopheesseera.

title: 'Scourge' of abuse must be rooted out, says Pope, during Lourdes visit
english: During his visit to France, the Pope urged Catholic bishops to remain vigilant and work hard to eliminate the widespread issue of child sexual abuse within the church. He delivered this strong message at the Lourdes sanctuary ahead of a private meeting with survivors of such abuse. This call to action follows a major investigation that revealed hundreds of thousands of children were victims of abuse by church members over several decades.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት በፈረንሳይ ባደረጉት ጉብኝት፣ የካቶሊክ ቤተክርስቲያን በውስጧ የሚፈጸመውን የሕፃናት ጾታዊ ጥቃት ለመቅረፍ ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ ለጳጳሳት ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ከጥቃት ሰለባዎች ጋር ከመገናኘታቸው በፊት በሉርድ በተካሄደው ስብሰባ ላይ፣ ይህንን አስከፊ ድርጊት በቆራጥነት ማስወገድ እንደሚገባ አሳስበዋል። ይህ የርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት መልእክት፣ ባለፉት ሰባት አስርት ዓመታት በፈረንሳይ በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሕፃናት በቤተክርስቲያን አባላት እንደተበደሉ ከታወቀ በኋላ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Papaan gara Faransaay imalaa turanirratti, abbootii amantii Kaatolikii kan ta’an biishoppotaan, waldaa keessatti miidhaa walqunnamtii saalaa ijoollerraa gahu hundeen buqqisuuf xiyyeeffannoo cimaa akka godhan dhaamaniiru. Miidhaa kana kan irra gahe namoota waliin walarguusaanii dura, bakka qulqulluu Luurd jedhamutti gorsa cimaa kana kennaniiru. Dhimmi kun kan ka’e, waggoota kudhanoota darban keessa Faransaay keessatti ijoolleen dhibbaan lakkaa’aman miseensota waldaatiin miidhaan irra gahuun isaanii qorannoon waan mirkanaa’eefidha.

title: Ten climbers missing after avalanche hits Himalayan base camp
english: Ten Nepalese mountain guides are currently missing after an avalanche struck their base camp near Himlung Himal on Sunday. The team was preparing routes for foreign climbers when heavy snowfall triggered the slide. Rescue operations have been unsuccessful so far due to severe weather conditions hindering helicopter access to the site.
amharic: በሂምሉንግ ሂማል ተራራ አቅራቢያ በተከሰተ የበረዶ መደርሰስ አደጋ አስር የኔፓል ተራራ መሪዎች የገቡበት ሳይታወቅ ጠፍተዋል። ቡድኑ የውጭ ሀገር ተጓዦችን መንገድ ለማዘጋጀት በቦታው ተገኝተው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በጠና በረዶ ምክንያት ድንገተኛ አደጋው ሊያጋጥማቸው ችሏል። በአካባቢው ያለው የከፋ የአየር ሁኔታ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን በመከልከሉ ሄሊኮፕተሮች ወደ ቦታው መድረስ አልቻሉም።
oromo: Gaara Himlung Himalitti kutaatti yeroo inni garaa lafaa fi cabbiin (avalanche) bu'etti, gaggeessitoonni gaaraa 10 ta'an badanii jiru. Gareen kun namoota biyya alaa gaaricha ba'uuf jiraniif karaan akka qophaa'u hojjetaa turan. Haalli qilleensaa baay'ee hamaa ta'uu isaa irraa kan ka'e, helikoptaroonni bakka sanatti gahuu waan hin dandeenyeef, tattaaffiin fayyisuu hanga ammaa bu'aa hin qabu.

title: Strait of Hormuz tensions linger as Iran and US move further from a deal
english: Tensions in the Strait of Hormuz have intensified after President Trump rejected a diplomatic proposal from Iran, leading to reports of renewed military activity in the waterway. Iran continues to restrict shipping routes and demand fees, while the US maintains that its naval forces are successfully protecting oil transit despite these blockades. The situation remains volatile as both nations distance themselves from a potential agreement.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የኢራንን የዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄ ሀሳብ ውድቅ ካደረጉ በኋላ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ ያለው ውጥረት አድጓል። ኢራን በባህር ወሽመጡ ላይ የራሷን የጉዞ ህጎች እና ክፍያዎች በመጫን መርከቦች እንዳይያልፉ ስትከለክል፣ አሜሪካ በበኩሏ የባህር ኃይሏ የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣዎችን በደህና እያሳለፈ መሆኑን ትገልጻለች። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ያለው ተስፋ እየራቀ በመሄዱ አካባቢው በከፍተኛ አለመረጋጋት ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Pirezedaanti Traamp yaada furmaata dippilomaasii kan Iraan dhiheessite diduun isaan booda, dhiphina galaana Hormuz keessatti bal'ateera. Iraan karaa galaanichaa irratti to'annoo cimaa gochuun, dooniiwwan hayyama isaanii malee darban irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu fi kaffaltii gaafachuu itti fufteetti. Gama biraan, Ameerikaan humnoonni galaana ishee dooniiwwan boba'aa dhiibbaa Iraan jiran keessaa nagaan baasuuf akka hojjechaa jiran ibsiteetti; haata'u malee, walii galtee irra ga'uun waan amansiisuu miti.

title: True Crime Reports: The Dosa King’s Deadly Obsession
english: A successful restaurant magnate known as the Dosa King faced legal trouble after a woman refused his romantic advances. Shortly after he threatened her, the woman's husband was found murdered. The case explores his nearly twenty-year battle to evade conviction despite his immense wealth and influence.
amharic: ዶሳ ኪንግ የተሰኘው የተሳካለት የምግብ ቤት ባለቤት በአንድ ሴት የፍቅር ጥያቄ ውድቅ ከተደረገ በኋላ ለህግ ችግር ተዳረገ። ሴትየዋን ካስፈራራት በኋላ ባሏ ሞቶ ተገኝቷል። ዘገባው ይህ ሰው ከፍተኛ ሀብትና ስልጣን ቢኖረውም ከፍትህ ለማምለጥ ለሃያ ዓመታት ያህል ያደረገውን ጥረት ይዳስሳል።
oromo: Abbaan qabeenyaa mana nyaataa milkaa’aa ta’e kan 'Dosa King' jedhamu, dubartii tokkoon yeroo inni jaalala ishee gaafatee didametti rakkina seeraa keessa gale. Erga inni dubartittii sodaachisee booda, abbaan manee ishee ajjeefamee argame. Gabaasni kun namni kun qabeenyaa fi aangoo guddaa qabaatus, seera jalaa ba’uuf waggoota digdamaaf yeroo inni falmaa ture irratti xiyyeeffata.

title: Yemen’s health system could collapse in some areas, minister warns
english: Yemen's Minister of Public Health has warned that the country's medical system faces a potential total collapse due to severe funding shortages and the ongoing conflict. With less than one-fifth of necessary financial support received, many facilities have shut down, leaving millions without access to essential care like vaccinations and emergency treatments. The situation is further worsened by mass displacement and rising disease outbreaks, making it difficult for the remaining, overwhelmed medical centers to manage the crisis.
amharic: የየመን የህዝብ ጤና ጥበቃ ሚኒስትር እንዳስታወቁት፣ በሀገሪቱ እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት እና የገንዘብ እጥረት የጤና ስርዓቱን ለከፍተኛ የመፈራረስ አደጋ ዳርጎታል። አስፈላጊው የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ካልተገኘ፣ ብዙ የጤና ተቋማት በመዘጋታቸው በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች መሰረታዊ የህክምና አገልግሎቶችን እያጡ ይገኛሉ። የህዝብ መፈናቀል እና የተላላፊ በሽታዎች መስፋፋት በችግሩ ላይ ተጨማሪ ጫና በመፍጠሩ፣ የተረፉት የጤና ተቋማትም ስራቸውን ለመቀጠል እየተቸገሩ ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri Fayyaa Yeman akka ibsetti, waraanni fi hanqinni baajataa sirni fayyaa biyyattii manca’uuf akka jedhu akeekkachiiseera. Gargaarsi maallaqaa kan barbaadamu keessaa harki xiqqoon qofa waan argameef, buufatni fayyaa hedduun cufamanii namoonni miliyoonaan lakka’aman tajaajila fayyaa argachuu dadhabaniiru. Kanaan walqabatee, baqaan namootaa fi dhibeewwan garaa garaa babal’achuun isaa raayyaa fayyaa kan jiran irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee jira.

title: Israel’s Smotrich calls for ‘war’ in West Bank: Rhetoric or real threat?
english: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has called for an all-out military offensive in the West Bank, suggesting that Israel should replicate the destructive tactics it used in Gaza. Experts are concerned that these inflammatory remarks, which include calls to dismantle the Palestinian Authority, could signal a dangerous escalation rather than just campaign rhetoric. This rhetoric follows a period of increasing violence and arrests by Israeli forces in the occupied territories.
amharic: የእስራኤል የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ቤዛልኤል ስሞትሪች በዌስት ባንክ ሙሉ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ ጥሪ ያቀረቡ ሲሆን እስራኤል በጋዛ የተጠቀመችበትን የአጥፊ ጦርነት ስልት በዚያም እንድትደግም ጠይቀዋል። የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች እነዚህ ንግግሮች የፓለስቲናዊ አስተዳደርን ለማፍረስ የታለሙ እና ወደ ከፋ ግጭት ሊያመሩ የሚችሉ በመሆናቸው እንደ ቀላል የፖለቲካ ፕሮፓጋንዳ መታየት እንደሌለባቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ አካሄድ ቀደም ሲል በተያዙት ግዛቶች እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እና የሰፈራ ግጭቶችን ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Israa'el Bezalel Smotrich naannoo Wanta Baankii keessatti waraana guutuu akka banamu waamicha dhiheessuun, Israa'el mala badiisaa Gaaza keessatti fayyadamte achittis akka raawwattu gaafataniiru. Akkaataa ibsa kanaan mootummaan Palastayinii akka diigamuufi tarkaanfiin kun qofa oolmaa filannoof kan hin taaneefi gara walitti buiinsa hamaatti geessuu danda'uuf jechuun ogeeyyoonni akeekkachiisu. Dubbiin kun erga naannawicha keessatti waraanniifi hidhaan Israa'el dabalaa dhufe booda kan dhaga'ameedha.

title: US installation commemorates victims of South African ‘white genocide’
english: A memorial featuring crosses was recently placed in Washington D.C. to highlight claims of a so-called white genocide targeting farmers in South Africa. The South African government has dismissed these allegations as false, emphasizing that crime and violence in the country are widespread issues affecting all racial groups. This narrative has previously gained international attention after being supported by former U.S. President Donald Trump.
amharic: በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ በደቡብ አፍሪካ ነጭ ገበሬዎች ላይ እየደረሰ ነው የተባለውን ‘የዘር ማጥፋት’ ወንጀል የሚያስታውስ የመታሰቢያ መስቀሎች ተተክለዋል። የደቡብ አፍሪካ መንግስት ይህንን ውንጀላ መሰረተ ቢስ ነው በማለት ውድቅ ያደረገው ሲሆን፣ በሀገሪቱ ያለው የወንጀልና የጥቃት አድማስ ሁሉንም ዘር የሚጎዳ እንደሆነ አስረድቷል። ይህ የሀሰት ወሬ ቀደም ሲል የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕን ጨምሮ በተወሰኑ አካላት ሲደገፍ ቆይቷል።
oromo: Waashingitan Diisii keessatti gargar tokko gargar baafamee mallattoon fannoo argamu, qonnaan bulaa Afrikaa Kibbaa irratti sanyii diimtuun akka raawwatame dubbatu tokko dhaabbateera. Mootummaan Afrikaa Kibbaa himannaa kana dhara fi bu'uura kan hin qabne jechuun kan komate yoo ta'u, yakki fi jeequmsi biyyattii keessatti mul'atu sanyii hunda irratti kan raawwatamu malee garee tokko qofa kan hin ilaallanne ta'uu ibseera. Yaadni sobaa kun kanaan dura prezidaantii Ameerikaa duraanii Doonald Tiraampii dabalatee namoota muraasaan deggaramaa tureera.

title: Trump expects US to hold talks with Iran this week, Axios says
english: Former President Donald Trump recently stated that he anticipates renewed diplomatic discussions between the United States and Iran. According to reports, these negotiations are expected to take place sometime this week. This development highlights ongoing efforts to engage in dialogue between the two nations.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርቡ እንደገለጹት በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል አዲስ የዲፕሎማሲ ንግግሮች እንደሚኖሩ ይጠብቃሉ። እንደ መረጃው ከሆነ እነዚህ ድርድሮች በዚህ ሳምንት ውስጥ ይካሄዳሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ውይይት ለማድረግ እየተደረጉ ያሉትን ጥረቶች የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantii duraanii Doonaald Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, gara fuulduraatti mariin diippiloomaasii kan Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti godhamu akka jiraatu abdatu. Gabaasoota akka argisiisanitti, mariin kun torban kana keessa akka gaggeeffamu eeggama. Taateen kun walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaan gidduutti marii taasisuuf tattaaffii godhamaa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: US rejects Iran’s claim of capturing underwater drone in Hormuz
english: The United States military has officially dismissed claims by Iran's Revolutionary Guard that they successfully captured an American underwater drone in the Strait of Hormuz. A US spokesperson stated that all their drone assets remain under complete American control and labeled the Iranian report as unfounded. Iran had previously alleged that it seized a Remus 600 submersible to analyze its data.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ውስጥ የአሜሪካን የውሃ ውስጥ ድሮን እንደያዙ የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ያቀረበውን ውንጀላ ውድቅ አድርጓል። የአሜሪካ የጦር ኃይል ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት ሁሉም የአሜሪካ ድሮኖች ሙሉ በሙሉ ቁጥጥር ስር ናቸው። ኢራን ቀደም ብላ የ'Remus 600' የተባለ ድሮን እንደያዘች እና መረጃዎቹን እየመረመረች መሆኑን ተናግራ ነበር።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa ibsa humnoonni waraana Iraan (Revolutionary Guard) daangaa galaana Hormuz keessatti diroonii bishaan jala deemtu tokko qabachuu isaanii ibsan fudhatama dhabsiiseera. Dubbi himaan waraana Ameerikaa diroononni isaanii hundi toannaa guutuu isaanii jala akka jiran ibsuun, himannaan Iraan dhara ta'uu ibseera. Iraan kanaan dura diroonii Remus 600 jedhamu qabachuu fi odeeffannoo isaa qorachaa jiraachuu dubbattee turte.

title: French military deployment to Saudi Arabia is ‘strictly defensive’, minister says
english: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot clarified that the deployment of French troops and defense systems to Saudi Arabia is intended solely for protection against Houthi attacks. He emphasized that these military assets are strictly defensive in nature to assist regional partners. Consequently, he stated that France is not involved in the conflict and does not consider itself a party to the ongoing war.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ዣን-ኖኤል ባሮት ወደ ሳውዲ አረቢያ የተላኩት የፈረንሳይ ወታደሮች እና የመከላከያ መሳሪያዎች የሁቲዎችን ጥቃት ለመከላከል ብቻ የታቀዱ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። እነዚህ ወታደራዊ ሀብቶች ለቅርብ አጋሮቻቸው ጥበቃ ለማድረግ የሚውሉ የመከላከያ ስልቶች እንጂ በጦርነቱ ውስጥ ተሳትፎ እንደሌላቸው አስረድተዋል። በዚህም ፈረንሳይ በግጭቱ ውስጥ ተዋጊ ወገን እንደማትሆን በግልጽ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri Dhimma Alaa Faransaay Zhaan-Noo'el Baaroot akka ibsetti, loltoonnii fi meeshaaleen ittisaa Faransaay gara Sa'udii Arabiyaatti ergame kanneen Hutiin isaan irratti raawwatan ittisuuf qofa kan kaayyeffate dha. Meeshaaleen waraanaa kunniin hiriyaa isaanii eeguuf kanneen fayyadan malee, Faransaay waraana sana keessatti akka hirmaattu kan taasisu miti jedhan. Haaluma kanaan, Faransaay lola sana keessatti garee akka hin taane fi ittisa qofaaf kan bobbaate ta'uu ishee mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Recap: Iran says war with US not over
english: Tensions between Iran and the U.S. persist as President Trump has rejected Tehran's terms for reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian military officials maintain that the conflict is ongoing and have issued threats regarding potential retaliation against U.S. assets. Meanwhile, regional instability continues with ongoing fighting in Gaza, Lebanon, and Yemen.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የኢራን የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን የመክፈቻ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎችን ውድቅ በማድረጋቸው በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለው ውጥረት ቀጥሏል። የኢራን ወታደራዊ አመራሮች ግጭቱ ገና አለማለቁን በመግለጽ በአሜሪካ ላይ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ዝተዋል። በተመሳሳይ መልኩ በጋዛ፣ በሊባኖስ እና በየመን ያለው የጸጥታ መደፍረስ ቀጥሎ ይገኛል።
oromo: Prezidaant Traamp haala Iraan bishaan Hormuz banuuf dhiheessite waan didaniif, waldhabdeen biyyoota lamaanii jidduu jiru itti fufeera. Ajajoonni waraana Iraan lola kana kan hin xumuramne ta'uu ibsuun, tarkaanfii waraana Ameerikaa irratti fudhachuu akka danda'an doorsisaniiru. Gam biraanis, naannichatti waraanni Gaazaa, Libaanoos fi Yamanitti itti fufee argama.

title: 'Do there what we did in Gaza': Smotrich calls for full-scale war in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has urged for a large-scale military offensive in the West Bank, suggesting it should mirror the actions taken in Gaza. He further advocated for the complete dismantling of the Palestinian Authority while maintaining his support for expanding illegal settlements. This rhetoric coincides with increased military checkpoints and movement restrictions imposed on Palestinians across the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ቤዛልኤል ስሞትሪች በዌስት ባንክ በጋዛ እንደተደረገው አይነት ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እንዲከፈት ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ሚኒስትሩ የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲፈርስ የጠየቁ ሲሆን፣ ሕገ-ወጥ ሰፈራዎችን ለማስፋፋት ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ዳግም አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ንግግር በአካባቢው በሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ እየተባባሰ የመጣው የፍተሻ ጣቢያዎች እና የጉዞ ገደቦች አካል ሆኖ መታየቱ ታውቋል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqaa Israa'el Bezalel Smotrich, naannoo Zilaa'i Bank (West Bank) keessatti waraana bal'aa gaggeessuun akkuma Gaazaatti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu akka qaban gaafataniiru. Innis bulchiinsi Falastiin guutummaatti diigamuu akka qabuufi babal'inni manneen jireenyaa seeraan alaa akka itti fufu deggertoota isaatti himaniiru. Yaanni kunis, naannichatti sochiin uummata Falastiin daangeffamuufi to'annoon waraanaa daran hammaachaa dhufuu waliin kan wal qabatedha.

title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that diplomacy is the only path to resolving the conflict after President Trump rejected a proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. While Trump dismissed the offer as unacceptable and claimed the US maintains full control of the waterway, Iran is awaiting a formal response through mediators. Iranian officials emphasize that building mutual trust and honoring past agreements are essential steps to ending the standoff.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን እንደገና ለመክፈት የቀረበውን ሀሳብ ውድቅ ካደረጉ በኋላ፣ ግጭቱን ለመፍታት ብቸኛው አማራጭ ድርድር ብቻ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ትራምፕ ሀሳቡን ተቀባይነት የሌለው ነው በማለት ውድቅ ቢያደርጉም፣ ኢራን በመካከለኞች በኩል ኦፊሴላዊ ምላሽ እየጠበቀች ትገኛለች። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ግጭቱን ለማብረድ መተማመንን መገንባት እና ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ ስምምነቶችን ማክበር ወሳኝ እንደሆኑ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbas Araagchi, Pireezidaant Traamp karaa Hormuz deebisanii banuuf dhiyeessii dhiyaate erga didanii booda, furmaanni tokkichi marii qofa akka ta'e ibsan. Traamp dhiyeessichi fudhatama akka hin qabne ibsanis, Iraan karaa giddu-galaan deebii sirrii ta'e eeggachaa jirti. Hojjettoonni mootummaa Iraan akka jedhanitti, walitti bu'insa kana dhaabuuf wal amantii uumuu fi waliigaltee kanaan dura ture kabajuun murteessaa dha.

title: Killer Christa Pike is to be executed within days - but her defence say she's a victim too
english: Christa Pike is scheduled for execution in Tennessee this week for the 1995 murder of Colleen Slemmer, a crime she committed when she was 18. Her legal team is requesting clemency, arguing that her history of severe childhood trauma was not properly considered by the jury and would likely prevent a death sentence today. While her supporters remember her as a kind person, the victim's family is seeking closure, and if carried out, she would be the first woman executed in the state in over two centuries.
amharic: ክሪስታ ፓይክ እ.ኤ.አ. በ1995 ኮሊን ስሌመርን በመግደሏ በቴነሲ ግዛት በቅርቡ የሞት ፍርድ ይጠብቃታል። ጠበቆቿ በልጅነቷ የደረሰባት ከፍተኛ በደል ለችሎቱ በወቅቱ አልቀረበም በማለት፣ ዛሬ ቢሆን ኖሮ እንዲህ አይነት ቅጣት እንደማይወሰንባት በመከራከር ይቅርታ እንዲደረግላት እየጠየቁ ነው። ተጎጂው ወገን ፍትህ እንዲሰፍን ሲጠይቅ፣ ይህ የሞት ፍርድ ከተፈፀመ ከሁለት መቶ ዓመታት በላይ በቴነሲ ግዛት የሴት እስረኛ ሲገደል የመጀመሪያው ይሆናል።
oromo: Krista Paayik bara 1995 dargaggeettii Kolin Slemeer ajjeesuu isheetiin torban kana keessa mootummaa Tenesii keessatti adabbii du'aatiif qophaa'aa jirti. Gareen abukaattoota ishee, dararaa cimaa ijoollummaa ishee keessa darbiteef ragaaleen gahaan yeroo sana akka hin dhiyaanne fi har'a ta'e utuu ta'ee adabbiin akkasii akka hin murtoofne falmaa jiru. Maatiin du'e sun haaloo ba'uu barbaadanis, adabbiin kun yoo raawwatame waggoota dhibba lamaa ol booda Tenesii keessatti dubartii ajjeesuun jalqabaa ta'a.

title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
english: A private helicopter crashed and caught fire near Montreal, Quebec, on Saturday afternoon, resulting in the death of all four people on board. Local authorities confirmed that emergency teams arrived at the scene shortly after the accident occurred. An investigation into the cause of the crash is currently underway, though identifying the victims is expected to take several days.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ከሰዓት በኋላ በኩቤክ፣ ሞንትሪያል አቅራቢያ የግል ሄሊኮፕተር ተከስክሶ በእሳት በመጋየቱ በውስጡ የነበሩ አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የአካባቢው የፖሊስ ባለስልጣናት የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ቦታው ላይ ደርሰው አራቱንም ተሳፋሪዎች በቦታው ላይ መሞታቸውን ማረጋገጣቸውን ገልጸዋል። የሄሊኮፕተሩ የመከስከስ ምክንያት እየተጣራ ሲሆን፣ የተጎጂዎችን ማንነት ለመለየት ጥቂት ቀናት ሊወስድ እንደሚችል ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe magaalaa Montreal, Quebec biratti xiyyaarri helicopterii dhuunfaa tokko kufuun isaa fi ibiddaan gubachuu isaa hordofee namoonni afur du’aniiru. Poolisiin naannichaa akka ibsetti, gargaarsa ariifachiisaa erga gaafatanii booda ogeeyyonni bakka sanatti yoo gahan namoonni kunneen du’uu isaanii mirkaneessaniiru. Sababa balaa kanaa ilaalchisee qorannoon jalqabamee kan jiru yoo ta’u, eenyummaa namoota du’anii adda baasuuf guyyoota muraasa akka fudhatu ibsameera.

title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead
english: South Africa is facing a surge in violence after two separate mass shootings near Johannesburg and Cape Town resulted in 27 deaths and many injuries. These attacks, which took place within hours of each other at nightlife venues, remain under investigation with no immediate arrests made. The country continues to battle high levels of gun crime often linked to gang activity, raising significant concerns about public safety.
amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ በዮሃንስበርግ እና በኬፕ ታውን አቅራቢያ በተፈጸሙ ሁለት ተከታታይ የጅምላ ተኩስ ጥቃቶች 27 ሰዎች መገደላቸውንና በርካቶች መቁሰላቸውን ተከትሎ የጸጥታ ስጋት ተባብሷል። በመዝናኛ ቦታዎች ላይ የተፈጸሙት እነዚህ ጥቃቶች እስካሁን በቁጥጥር ስር የዋለ ተጠርጣሪ የለም። በሀገሪቱ በወንበዴዎች እና በህገ-ወጥ ድርጊቶች ሳቢያ የሚከሰተው የሽጉጥ ጥቃት ለህዝብ ደህንነት ትልቅ ስጋት መሆኑ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: ደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ ዮሃንስበርግ እና ኬፕ ታውን አቅራቢያ በተፈጸሙ ሁለት ተከታታይ የጅምላ ተኩስ ጥቃቶች 27 ሰዎች የተገደሉ ሲሆን ሌሎች በርካቶች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በመዝናኛ ቦታዎች ላይ የተፈጸሙት እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ምርመራ እየተደረገባቸው ሲሆን እስካሁን በቁጥጥር ስር የዋለ አካል የለም። በሀገሪቱ በቡድን የሚፈጸሙ የጦር መሳሪያ ጥቃቶች እየተባባሱ መምጣታቸው ለህዝብ ደህንነት ትልቅ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።

title: ‘My hands are empty’: Displaced Palestinians struggle to survive
english: Displaced Palestinians from the Tulkarem refugee camp are facing severe poverty and debt after being forced from their homes. Many individuals, such as Hakim Mar’i, are suffering from untreated medical conditions and lack the means to pay for basic necessities like electricity. With their community destroyed and their savings depleted, these families are struggling to survive in overcrowded and inadequate temporary shelters.
amharic: ከቱልካረም መጠለያ ጣቢያ የተፈናቀሉ ፍልስጤማውያን ከቤታቸው በመፈናቀላቸው ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ድህነት እና እዳ ውስጥ ወድቀዋል። እንደ ሀኪም ማሪ ያሉ ግለሰቦች ህክምና ማግኘት ተስኗቸው እና እንደ ኤሌክትሪክ ያሉ መሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶችን ማሟላት አልቻሉም። መኖሪያ ቤታቸው በመውደሙ እና ያላቸው ሀብት በማለቁ ምክንያት እነዚህ ቤተሰቦች በአስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ በጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች ለመኖር እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Namoonni buufata baqattootaa Tulkarem irraa buqqa'an, mana isaanii dhabuun hiyyummaa fi liqii ulfaataa keessa jiru. Namoonni akka Hakim Mar’i jiran, wal’ansa fayyaa argachuu fi haala mijaataatti jiraachuu dadhabuun miidhaa hamaa keessa jiru. Qabeenyi isaanii barbadaa’uu fi iddoon jireenyaa dhabamuun, maatiiwwan kun rakkoo cimaa fi haala itti fufiinsa hin qabne keessa jiraachuuf qabsaa'aa jiru.

title: Israeli minister Bezalel Smotrich calls for war in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has called for military action in the occupied West Bank similar to the campaign in Gaza, suggesting the Palestinian Authority should be dismantled. This statement comes amidst rising violence in the region and a week-long military lockdown imposed by Israel for the Sukkot holiday. Human rights organizations have expressed alarm over the significant increase in settler attacks against Palestinians in the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፋይናንስ ሚኒስትር ቤዛለል ስሞትሪች በእስራኤል የተያዘው ምዕራባዊ የዮርዳኖስ ዳርቻ ላይ በጋዛ እንደተደረገው አይነት ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ሚኒስትሩ የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር መፍረስ እንዳለበት የተናገሩ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ንግግራቸው በእስራኤል ለሱኮት በዓል በተጣለው የአንድ ሳምንት ሙሉ የጦር ሰራዊት እገዳ ወቅት ተሰምቷል። በአካባቢው በሚኖሩ እስራኤላዊያን ሰፋሪዎች በኩል በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ እየደረሰ ያለው ጥቃት በእጅጉ መጨመሩ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾችን ስጋት ላይ ጥሏል።
oromo: Ministeerri Faayinaansii Israa'el Bezalel Smotrich, naannoo Qilleensa-gadii (West Bank) keessatti tarkaanfiin waraanaa akka fudhatamuufi kanneen Gaazaa keessatti raawwataman akka irra deebi'aman gaafataniiru. Yaada isaanii kanaan mootummaan biyyaalessaa Falasxiin akka diigamu kan gaafatan yoo ta'u, kunis yeroo Israa'el ayyaana Sukoot ilaalchisee naannichatti cufiinsa waraanaa cimaa labsiteetti. Dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa weerara warra buufatanii (settlers) Falasxiinota irratti raawwatanii fi guddachaa jiru kana irratti yaaddoo guddaa qabu.

title: Yemen government forces widen attacks against Houthis: What we know
english: Yemeni government forces have launched a series of air and ground attacks against Houthi rebels in the Taiz province following recent losses of strategic territory. These military operations aim to halt the group's advance and reclaim areas like the Red Sea city of Mocha. The escalation in fighting since July has forced over 130,000 civilians to flee their homes, causing a severe humanitarian crisis.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ሰራዊት ከቅርብ ጊዜ ወዲህ በታኢዝ ግዛት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ የአየር እና የምድር ጥቃቶችን አጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል። መንግስት ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ቁልፍ ቦታዎችን መቆጣጠራቸውን ተከትሎ የጠፉ ግዛቶችን ለማስመለስ ነው። ከሀምሌ ወር ጀምሮ በተቀሰቀሰው ግጭት ከ130,000 በላይ ሰዎች ከቀያቸው የተፈናቀሉ ሲሆን የሰብአዊ ቀውሱም አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yemen naannoo Ta’izitti garee Huutii irratti haleellaa qilleensaafi lafaa cimaa gaggeessaa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga gareen Huutii lafa tarsiimawaa ta’e tokko to’annaa isaa jala oolchee booda kanneen dhabaman deebisanii qabachuufi. Waraana Ji'a Adooleessaa irraa kaasee dhalateen namoonni kuma 130 ol ta’an buqqa’anii jiru, kunis rakkoo namoomaa cimaa uumee jira.

title: Plane carrying DR Congo military delegation crashes
english: A military aircraft recently crashed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, resulting in the deaths of 17 individuals. The victims included four civilians and two high-ranking military officials who were part of an official delegation. Authorities are currently looking into the circumstances to determine what caused the accident.
amharic: በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ የጦር ኃይሎች ልዑካን ቡድን የያዘ አውሮፕላን ተከስክሶ አስራ ሰባት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በአደጋው ህይወታቸው ካለፈው መካከል አራት ሲቪሎች እና ሁለት ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ መኮንኖች ይገኙበታል። ባለስልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Xiyyaarri ergamtoota waraanaa Rippabiliika Dimookiraatawaa Koongoo fe'ee deemaa ture tokko kufee namootni 17 lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Miidhamtoota kana keessaa namootni siivilii afur fi ajajoonni waraanaa olaanoo lama kan argaman yoo ta'u, aangawonni sababa kuffatii xiyyaarichaa irratti qorannoo gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Malaysia’s Ng, Sivasangari book LA28 Olympics berth with Asian Games gold
english: Malaysian squash players Eain Yow Ng and Sivasangari Subramaniam have become the first athletes to secure spots in the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. By winning gold medals at the Asian Games in Japan, the pair earned automatic qualification for the sport's debut in the Olympic program. Both champions successfully defended their Asian Games titles with dominant performances against their Indian opponents.
amharic: የማሌዢያው የስኳሽ ተጫዋቾች ኢይን ያው ንግ እና ሲቫሳንጋሪ ሱብራማኒያም በ2028 የሎስ አንጀለስ ኦሊምፒክ ላይ ለመሳተፍ የመጀመሪያዎቹ አትሌቶች ሆነዋል። በጃፓን በተካሄደው የእስያ ጨዋታዎች የወርቅ ሜዳሊያ በማሸነፋቸው፣ ስኳሽ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በኦሊምፒክ ፕሮግራም ሲካተት በራስ-ሰር ለመወዳደር ብቁ ሆነዋል። ሁለቱም አሸናፊዎች በህንድ አቻዎቻቸው ላይ ጠንካራ ብቃታቸውን በማሳየት የዋንጫ ክብራቸውን በተሳካ ሁኔታ አስከብረዋል።
oromo: Atileetonni isquashii biyya Maleeshiyaa Eain Yow Ng fi Sivasangari Subramaniam, ispoortii isquashii jalqabaaf sagantaa Olompikii irratti yeroo hirmaatu, Olompikii Los Angeles 2028 irratti hirmaachuuf qulquloofatan. Atileetonni kun tapha 'Asian Games' Jaappanitti gaggeeffame irratti meedaaliyaa warqee fudhachuun isaanii, carraa Olompikii irratti hirmaachuu isaanii mirkaneesseef. Atileetonni kunneen morkattoota isaanii kan Hindii injifachuun, qophii isaan godhataniin sadarkaa isaanii ittisuu danda'aniiru.

title: Huge crowds cheer Pope Leo as he leads open-air Mass in Paris
english: Pope Leo XIV recently held a massive outdoor Mass at the Place de la Concorde in Paris, which was attended by approximately 800,000 people. This event was a central part of his official visit to France. Additionally, the Pope traveled to Lourdes to participate in prayers with thousands of faithful followers at the Grotto of Massabielle.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በፓሪስ ፕላስ ደ ላ ኮንኮርድ በተካሄደው የሜዳ ላይ መስዋዕተ ቅዳሴ ላይ ወደ 800,000 የሚጠጉ ምዕመናንን ሰብስበዋል። ይህ ዝግጅት ለፈረንሳይ ጉብኝታቸው ትልቅ አካል ነበር። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም ሊቀ ጳጳሳቱ ወደ ሉርድ በመጓዝ በማሳቤል ዋሻ ውስጥ ከሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ አማኞች ጋር በጋራ ጸልየዋል።
oromo: Paphaasii Leo XIV, Paarisitti bakka 'Place de la Concorde' jedhamuutti qilleensa banamaa keessatti qulqulluu qiddasee kan geggeessan yoo ta'u, namoonni 800,000 ol ta'an hirmaataniiru. Ayyaanni kun daawwannaa isaanii kan Faransaay keessatti bakka guddaa qaba. Akkasumas, paphaasichi gara magaalatti Lourdes imaluun, bakka 'Grotto of Massabielle' jedhamutti namoota kumaatamaan lakka'aman wajjin kadhannaa gaggeessaniiru.

title: Ethiopia’s army promises restraint amid fears of new civil war
english: The Ethiopian military reports it is handling recent outbreaks of violence in the northern regions with caution to avoid a full-scale civil war. The Army Chief of Staff accused Eritrea of backing rebel factions, a claim Eritrea has denied, while both the government and Tigrayan forces report significant ongoing clashes. These developments have caused global concern, as they severely threaten the stability of the 2022 peace agreement.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ መከላከያ ሠራዊት በሰሜን ኢትዮጵያ የተቀሰቀሰውን ግጭት አገሪቱን ወደ አዲስ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት እንዳይመራ በጥንቃቄ እየያዘው መሆኑን አስታውቋል። የጦር ኃይሎች ጠቅላይ ኤታማዦር ሹም ኤርትራ ታጣቂዎችን ትረዳለች ሲሉ የከሰሱ ሲሆን፣ ኤርትራ ግን ይህንን አስተባብላለች። በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል እየተካሄደ ያለው ተደጋጋሚ ግጭት በ2014 ዓ.ም የተፈረመውን የሰላም ስምምነት አደጋ ላይ ጥሎታል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Itoophiyaa naannoo kaabaatti lola ka’e gara waraana biyyaatti akka hin geessine of eeggannoon akka hojjechaa jiru ibseera. Ajajaan waraanaa mootummaan Ertiraa garee finxaaleyyiif deeggarsa akka gootu himus, Ertiraan himannaa kana haalteetti. Walitti bu’iinsi kunis waliigaltee nageenyaa bara 2022 irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee jira.

title: Detained Tunisian flotilla activists: Worsening health amid family anguish
english: Four Tunisian activists associated with the Sumud Flotilla are currently being held in detention, where they face severe health complications and physical deterioration. Their families are suffering deeply, with children experiencing emotional trauma and distress due to the prolonged separation from their fathers. Despite their precarious situation, loved ones continue to advocate for their release while sharing stories of the activists' past heroism and commitment to social justice.
amharic: የሱሙድ ፍሎቲላ አባል የሆኑ አራት የቱኒዚያ አክቲቪስቶች በእስር ላይ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት የጤና ሁኔታቸው በጣም እያሽቆለቆለ ይገኛል። ቤተሰቦቻቸውም ከሚወዳቸው ሰዎች በመለየታቸው ከፍተኛ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ እና ስቃይ እየደረሰባቸው ሲሆን በተለይም ልጆቻቸው ላይ የሚታየው ተጽእኖ ከፍተኛ ነው። እነዚህ ቤተሰቦች የአክቲቪስቶቹን መፈታት እየጠየቁ ስለ እነርሱ የቀድሞ በጎ ተግባራት እና ለፍትህ ያላቸውን ቁርጠኝነት በመመስከር ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni fi duuka buutonni Sumud Flotilla kan ta'an lammiileen Tunisiyaa afur hidhaa keessa jiru, yeroo ammaa kana fayyaan isaanii baay'ee gadadaa jira. Maatiin isaanii fi ijoolleen isaanii fira isaanii irraa adda ba'uu irraa kan ka'e rakkoo cimaa fi miira qaamaa keessa jiru. Maatiin hidhamtoota kanaa hidhamtootni kun mirgaaf qabsaa'ota akka ta'an dubbatuu fi akka gadi lakkifaman gaafachaa jiru.

title: German, Russian foreign ministers hold rare talks amid rising tensions
english: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul and Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov held rare, high-level discussions in New York on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. Their meeting, the first since the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, focused on easing regional tensions and addressing issues like Black Sea grain exports. Despite the dialogue, Lavrov dismissed German concerns about escalation, and both nations remain deeply divided over the ongoing conflict and recent security incidents.
amharic: የጀርመን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ዮሃን ዋዴፉል እና የሩሲያው አቻቸው ሰርጌይ ላቭሮቭ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ጎን ለጎን በኒውዮርክ ያልተለመደ የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይት አድርገዋል። ከ2022 የዩክሬን ጦርነት በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በተደረገው በዚህ ስብሰባ፣ ሁለቱ ወገኖች በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት ስለማርገብ እና በጥቁር ባህር በኩል ስለሚካሄድ የእህል ንግድ ተወያይተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ውይይቱ ቢኖርም፣ ላቭሮቭ የጀርመንን ስጋት ውድቅ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው የፖለቲካ ልዩነት አሁንም እንደቀጠለ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Jarman Johann Wadephul fi ministirri dhimma alaa Raashiya Sergey Lavrov qarqara walgahii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa irratti magaala New Yorkitti marii kan taasisan yoo ta'u, kunis marii dhimma alaa idilee keessatti kan hin beekamneedha. Mariin kun waraana Uukreen bara 2022 eegale booda kan jalqabaa yoo ta'u, mariin isaaniis dhiphina naannoo sanaa hir'isuu fi dhimma ergaa midhaan biqiltuu galaana gurraacha irratti kan xiyyeeffatedha. Haa ta'u malee, marii kana keessatti Lavrov yaaddoo Jarmanin ka'e fudhatama dhabsiisuun, walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota lamaanii dhimmoota waraanaa fi nageenyaa irratti ammas wal-dhabdee cimaa akka qaban agarsiiseera.

title: Bangkok declared disaster zone after heavy rains submerge roads
english: Bangkok has been officially designated a disaster area following intense rainfall that caused severe flooding across the city. The extreme weather overwhelmed local drainage systems and canals after some areas received up to 300 millimeters of water. Authorities are currently dealing with submerged roads and the significant impact these floods have had on the capital's infrastructure.
amharic: ባንኮክ በጣለባት ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት ከተማዋ በጎርፍ በመጥለቅለቋ መንግስት የአደጋ ቀጠና ሆና እንድትታወጅ አድርጓል። በአንዳንድ የከተማዋ አካባቢዎች እስከ 300 ሚሊሜትር የሚደርስ ዝናብ በመዝነቡ የፍሳሽ ማስወገጃዎች እና ቦዮች አቅም በላይ ሆነዋል። ይህ ከባድ ዝናብ መንገዶችን በማጥለቅለቁ ለከተማዋ መሠረተ ልማት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አስከትሏል።
oromo: Roobni cimaan guyyoota darban magaalattiitti roobee ture lolaa guddaa waan uumeef, Baangkookiin naannoo balaa mudate jedhamee labsameera. Roobni hamma millimeetira 300 gahu bakka tokko tokkotti roobuu isaa hordofee, sirni bishaan gadi dhiisuu magaalaattii guutummaatti cufameera. Lolaa kanaanis daandiileen gurguddoon bishaaniin liqimfamuun tajaajila adda kutaniiru.

title: A FIRE LIT FOR PEACE, IN THE RAIN
english: Thousands of people gathered at Meskel Square in Addis Ababa for the traditional Demera bonfire celebration despite heavy rain. This year's festival emphasized themes of national reconciliation and unity amid ongoing political and ethnic tensions in Ethiopia. Religious and government leaders used the event to call for forgiveness, patience, and a collective commitment to lasting peace across the country.
amharic: በአዲስ አበባ መስቀል አደባባይ በዝናብ ታጅቦ የተከበረው የደመራ በዓል በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ምዕመናን ተገኝተዋል። የዘንድሮው በዓል በኢትዮጵያ ያለውን የፖለቲካና የብሄር ግጭቶች ለመፍታት የሚያስችል የሰላምና የአንድነት መልዕክት ላይ ትኩረት አድርጓል። የመንግስትና የሃይማኖት መሪዎች ህዝቡ ልዩነቶችን በመተው በትዕግስትና በይቅርታ ለዘላቂ ሰላም እንዲቆም ጥሪ አስተላልፈዋል።
oromo: Ayyaanni Dameraa guyyaa kaleessaa bakka bu'oota amantii kumaatamaan lakka'amaniin magaalaa Finfinnee, masqala Isquwaariitti, roobaa cimaa keessatti kabajameera. Ayyaanni kun yeroo kanatti biyyattii keessatti rakkoolee siyaasaa fi sanyiin wal qabatan jiran furuuf, tokkummaa fi nagaa irratti xiyyeeffateera. Hogganoonni amantii fi mootummaa, uummanni garaagarummaa isaa dagatee, dhiifamaa fi obsaan nagaa biyyattii akka mirkaneessu dhaamaniiru.

title: A Holiday Homecoming Buckles Under Rising Bus Fares
english: Rising bus fares are making it increasingly difficult for many people to travel home for the Meskel holiday. While many remain determined to visit their families, the high costs are forcing them to travel in smaller groups, bring fewer gifts, or cancel their plans entirely. This financial strain is changing the traditional experience of holiday reunions for many families.
amharic: የአውቶቡስ ትኬት ዋጋ መወደድ ለመስቀል በዓል ወደ ቤተሰቦቻቸው ለመጓዝ ለሚፈልጉ ሰዎች ከፍተኛ ፈተና ሆኗል። ብዙዎች በዓሉን ከቤተሰቦቻቸው ጋር ለማሳለፍ ቢፈልጉም፣ በዋጋ ጭማሪው ምክንያት በቡድን ከመጓዝ ይልቅ በተናጠል ለመሄድ፣ ስጦታዎችን ለመቀነስ ወይም ጉዞአቸውን ሙሉ በሙሉ ለመሰረዝ ተገደዋል። ይህ የኑሮ ጫና የባህላዊ በዓል አከባበርን እና የቤተሰብ መገናኘትን መንገድ እየቀየረው ይገኛል።
oromo: Gatiin konkolaataa dabaluun namoota baay'ee ayyaana Masqalaatiif gara maatii isaanii deemuuf carraaqan irratti gufuu ta'eera. Hedduun isaanii maatii isaanii wajjin ayyaaneeffachuuf fedhii qabaatanis, gatii meeshaalee fi imala qaaliin ta'e irraa kan ka'e, namoonni baay'een imala isaanii haquuf ykn kennaa xiqqoo qabatanii deemuu dirqamaniiru. Kuni imala ayyaanaatiin wal-qunnamuun aadaa ture irratti jijjiirama fiduu qabatee jira.

title: Fed Pours Billions into Cheap Fuel the IMF Says It Should Drop
english: The International Monetary Fund has urged the Ethiopian government to eliminate broad fuel subsidies once global market prices stabilize. While the government is currently capping subsidy costs and supporting state importers, the IMF argues that ending these payments will improve financial stability. Phasing out this aid is intended to redirect public funds toward more productive national development projects.
amharic: የዓለም የገንዘብ ድርጅት (IMF) ዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ሲረጋጋ ኢትዮጵያ በነዳጅ ላይ የምታደርገውን ሰፊ ድጎማ እንድታቆም መክሯል። መንግሥት በአሁኑ ወቅት የድጎማ ወጪዎችን በመገደብ እና ለነዳጅ አስመጪ ድርጅቶች ድጋፍ በማድረግ ላይ ቢገኝም፣ ድርጅቱ ይህ ድጋፍ የሀገሪቱን የፋይናንስ አቅም ለማጠናከር መቋረጥ አለበት ብሏል። ይህ እርምጃ ለልማት ስራዎች የሚውል በጀት ለመቆጠብ እንደሚያስችልም ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mallaqa Addunyaa (IMF) gatiin boba'aa gabaa addunyaa irratti yeroo tasgabbaa'u, mootummaan Itoophiyaa gargaarsa gatii boba'aa bal'inaan kennamu dhaabuu akka qabu gorseera. Mootummaan ammaaf baasii gargaarsaa muruufi dhaabbilee boba'aa gurguddaaf deeggarsa gochuuf yaalii gochaa jiraatus, IMF akka jedhutti deeggarsa kana dhaabuun dhaabbata maallaqaa biyyattii cimsuuf barbaachisaadha. Tarkaanfiin kun qabeenya mootummaa hojiiwwan misooma biyyaaf oolchuuf gargaara.

title: Banks Baulk at a Bill from Public ID That Turns Commercial
english: FaydaVerse, the state-run entity managing Ethiopia's digital ID system, has started demanding fees from commercial banks for identity verification services that were previously provided at no cost. The company claims these charges are necessary to ensure its financial sustainability as a state-owned enterprise. In response, banking institutions are strongly opposing the new contractual requirements for these authentication checks.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያን ዲጂታል መታወቂያ ሥርዓት የሚያስተዳድረው ፋይዳቨርስ (FaydaVerse) ለንግድ ባንኮች ከዚህ ቀደም በነፃ ይሰጥ የነበረውን የማንነት ማረጋገጫ አገልግሎት አሁን በክፍያ እንዲፈጽሙ እየጠየቀ ነው። ድርጅቱ ይህ ውሳኔ የፋይናንስ አቅሙን ለማጠናከር እና ሥራውን ለማስቀጠል አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ ይገልጻል። የንግድ ባንኮች በበኩላቸው በአዲሱ የክፍያ ስምምነት ላይ ጠንካራ ተቃውሞ እያሰሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hojjettoota sirna eenyummaa dijitaalaa Itoophiyaa kan ta'e FaydaVerse, tajaajila eenyummaa mirkaneessuu kan kanaan dura baasii malee kennamaa tureef, amma baankota irraa kaffaltii gaafachuu jalqabeera. Dhaabbatichi kaffaltiin kun hojii isaa itti fufsiisuuf akka barbaachisu ibseera. Baankonni daldalaa garuu, kaffaltii haaraa fi waliigaltee dhiyaate kana cimsee mormaa jira.

title: Ethiopia Nears a WTO Seat It May Struggle to Cash In
english: Ethiopia is approaching the final stages of its long-term efforts to become a member of the World Trade Organization. While this move aims to boost international trade, experts suggest the country may face significant challenges in fully leveraging the benefits of membership. Successful integration will depend on the government's ability to modernize its economy and navigate complex global market requirements.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ ለረጅም ጊዜ ስትጥርበት የነበረውን የአለም የንግድ ድርጅት አባልነት የመጨረሻ ምዕራፍ ላይ ደርሳለች። ይህ እርምጃ ዓለም አቀፍ ንግድን ለማሳደግ ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ ሀገሪቱ ከአባልነቷ ሙሉ በሙሉ ተጠቃሚ ለመሆን ትልቅ ፈተናዎች ሊገጥሟት እንደሚችሉ ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ። ስኬታማ የንግድ ውህደት የተመሰረተው መንግስት ኢኮኖሚውን ዘመናዊ ለማድረግ እና ውስብስብ የሆኑ የአለም ገበያ መስፈርቶችን ለማሟላት በሚያደርገው ጥረት ላይ ነው።
oromo: Itoophiyaan miseensa Dhaabbata Daldalaa Addunyaa ta'uuf carraaqqii dheeraa gochaa turte gara xumuraatti geessiseetti. Tarkaanfiin kun daldala idil-addunyaa gabbisuuf kan karoorfame ta'us, biyyattiin fayyadamoo ta'uuf rakkoolee hedduu akka qabdu ogeeyyonni ni himu. Milkaa'inni Itoophiyaa guddina diinagdee ishee ammayyeessuu fi gabaa addunyaa waliin walitti makamuuf dandeettii ishee irratti kan hundaa'e ta'a.

title: Iran war live: Tehran awaits official response as Trump rejects Hormuz plan
english: The Iranian government is currently waiting for a formal response from the United States regarding a proposed plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. President Donald Trump has officially rejected Iran's seven-day roadmap, stating that the proposal is not acceptable to his administration. Consequently, Iranian officials have expressed deep skepticism about the value of continuing future diplomatic negotiations with Washington.
amharic: የኢራን መንግሥት የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን እንደገና ለመክፈት ያቀረበው ዕቅድ ላይ ከአሜሪካ ይፋዊ ምላሽ እየጠበቀ ይገኛል። የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኢራንን የሰባት ቀን የሥራ ዕቅድ ተቀባይነት እንደሌለው በመግለጽ ውድቅ አድርገውታል። በዚህም የተነሳ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ከዋሽንግተን ጋር በሚደረጉ ድርድሮች ላይ ያላቸው እምነት እንደቀነሰ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Iran karaa galaana Hormuz banuuf karoorashee erga dhiyeessitee booda, deebii semaata ta'e mootummaa Ameerikaa irraa eeggachaa jirti. Prezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp karoora guyyaa torbaa Iran dhiyeessite kan hin fudhatamne ta'uu ibsuun kufaa godhaniiru. Haaluma kanaan, hoggantoonni Iran marii gara fuulduraa kan Waashingitan waliin taasisan irratti amantaa akka hin qabne beeksisaniiru.

title: Pezeshkian says Iran ‘no longer trusts talks with Washington’
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has stated that Tehran has lost faith in diplomatic discussions with the United States due to past instances of sanctions and military aggression. This declaration follows a rejected Iranian proposal regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Consequently, current tensions between the two nations remain high as dialogue efforts appear to be stalled.
amharic: የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ ፔዜሽኪያን ካለፉት ማዕቀቦች እና ጥቃቶች በኋላ ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ጋር በሚደረግ ድርድር ላይ እምነት እንደሌላቸው ገልጸዋል። ይህ አስተያየት የተሰጠው ኢራን የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን እንደገና ለመክፈት ያቀረበችውን ሃሳብ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ውድቅ ካደረጉ በኋላ ነው። በዚህም ሳቢያ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ውጥረት በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeshkian akka jedhanitti, Iraan dararamaa fi kanaan dura tarkaaffiiwwan dippiloomaasii booda haala irra turtee fi cinaatti dhiibbaa diinagdee ishee irra ga'een booda, marii Waashingitan waliin taasifamu irratti amantii akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun kan kenname Donald Traamp dhiyeessiin Iraan daandii galaana Hormuz banuuf dhiyeessite erga didanii booda. Haala kanaan, walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota lamaanii gidduu jiru hammaatee kan itti fufe yoo ta'u, mariin dippiloomaasii akka dhaabate mul'ata.

title: Four American tourists among 6 killed in suspected gas leak blast in Athens
english: A massive explosion, likely triggered by a gas leak, destroyed a two-story building in the historic Plaka district of Athens, resulting in six deaths. The victims include four American tourists and an elderly couple who lived on the premises. Local residents had previously warned authorities about potential gas safety issues in the area, and emergency crews are currently assessing the structural stability of nearby buildings.
amharic: በአቴንስ ታሪካዊው የፕላካ ሰፈር በጋዝ መፍሰስ ምክንያት በተከሰተ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታ የአንድ ባለ ሁለት ፎቅ ሕንፃ በመፍረሱ ስድስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል አራቱ አሜሪካውያን ቱሪስቶች ሲሆኑ ቀሪዎቹ ደግሞ በዚያው ሕንፃ ውስጥ ይኖሩ የነበሩ አረጋውያን ጥንዶች ናቸው። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ቀደም ብለው ስለ ጋዝ መፍሰስ ስጋት ለባለሥልጣናት ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተው እንደነበር የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ አሁን የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በአካባቢው ያሉ ሌሎች ሕንፃዎችን ደህንነት በመገምገም ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Atensiitti naannoo seena-qabeessa Pilaakaatti dhoohiinsa gaazii irraa ka'e jedhamee shakkamuun mana darbii lamaa diigamee lubbuun namoota jahaa darbeera. Miidhamtoota kana keessaa afur tuuristoota Ameerikaa yoo ta'an, lama immoo namoota achuma mana sana keessa jiraachaa turani. Jiraattonni naannichaa dhoohiinsi kun osoo hin ta'in dura waa'ee dhangala'aa gaazii abbootii taayitaatti gorsanii akka turan kan ibsame yoo ta'u, amma gareen fayyisuu miidhaawwan biroo ittisuuf qophiirra jiru.

title: Powerful storm brings flooding, power outages to northeastern United States
english: A severe storm has struck the northeastern United States, causing widespread flooding, significant power outages, and the cancellation of hundreds of flights. State officials have declared emergencies and are urging citizens to avoid dangerous water conditions as high winds and heavy rain continue. While nor'easters are common in the region, this event is occurring earlier in the season than typically expected.
amharic: ኃይለኛ አውሎ ንፋስ በአሜሪካ ሰሜን ምስራቅ አካባቢዎች ከፍተኛ ጎርፍ እና የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ አስከትሏል። በዚህ ምክንያት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ በረራዎች ተሰርዘዋል፣ ባለስልጣናትም የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ በማወጅ ህብረተሰቡ ከውሃ አካባቢዎች እንዲርቅ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን እንደዚህ አይነት አውሎ ንፋስ በዚህ ወቅት የተለመደ ቢሆንም፣ የዘንድሮው ከወትሮው ቀደም ብሎ በመከሰቱ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin cimaan tokko naannoo kaaba-bahaa Yuunaayitid Isteetisitti mudatee lolaa cimaa fi humna ibsaa hir’achuu hordofsiiseera. Hojiin balallii xiyyaaraa dhibbaan lakkaa’amu addaan kan cite yoo ta’u, abbootiin taayitaa labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa labsuun namootni qarqara bishaanii fi bakka lolaan jiru irraa akka fagaatan akeekkachiisaniiru. Obomboleettiin akkanaa yeroo kana naannichatti kan barame ta’us, kan bara kanaa yeroo baramaa dursee dhufuun isaa yaaddoo uumee jira.

title: Deadly shooting hits Caribbean islands of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
english: A violent shooting in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines has left four people dead and four others injured near the capital, Kingstown. Police believe the attack was linked to ongoing gang retaliations, though no suspects have been arrested yet. Authorities are now increasing security patrols and urging the youth to avoid criminal activities to ensure public safety in this popular tourism destination.
amharic: በቅዱስ ቪንሰንት እና ግሬናዲንስ ዋና ከተማ ኪንግስቲን አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የሽጉጥ ጥቃት አራት ሰዎች ሲገደሉ አራት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ፖሊስ ጥቃቱ በቡድኖች መካከል ከሚፈጠር ግጭት ጋር የተያያዘ እንደሆነ ቢጠረጥርም እስካሁን ምንም አይነት እስር አልተፈጸመም። መንግስት የጸጥታ ጥበቃን ያጠናከረ ሲሆን ወጣቶች ከወንጀል ድርጊቶች እንዲርቁ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Saint Vincent fi Grenadines magaalaa guddoo Kingstown jedhamtu biratti dhukaasa banameen namoonni afur du'anii kan biroon afur immoo madaa'aniiru. Poolisiin haleellaan kun walitti bu'iinsa garee yakkaa waliin walqabata jedhee kan amanu yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti nama shakkame tokko illee hin qabne. Aangawaanni biyyattii nageenya naannichaa cimsuuf tarkaanfii fudhachaa jiran yoo ta'u, dargaggoonni yakka irraa akka fagaatan dhaamaniiru.

title: Israel's attorney general orders postponement of E1 settlement tender
english: Israel's attorney general has delayed a bidding process for new housing units in the E1 West Bank settlement by one month to keep it out of the national election campaigns. This project, which involves over 1,200 homes, has drawn international concern because it could block movement between Palestinian areas and damage the possibility of a two-state solution. Critics also point out that the plan threatens regional stability and comes during a period of rising violence.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ አቃቤ ህግ በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚገኘው የኢ-1 ሰፈራ ግንባታ ጨረታ ከምርጫ ዘመቻ ጋር እንዳይገናኝ የአንድ ወር እገዳ ጥሏል። ከ1,200 በላይ ቤቶችን ያካተተው ይህ ፕሮጀክት በፍልስጤማውያን መካከል ያለውን የትራንስፖርት እንቅስቃሴ የሚያስተጓጉል በመሆኑ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ይህም የሁለት ሀገር የመፍትሄ ሃሳብን የሚጎዳ እና በክልሉ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት የሚያባብስ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa Israa'el sagantaa ijaarsa manneen jireenyaa naannoo E1 kan Qarqara Dhihaatti (West Bank) guyyoota 30f akka tursiisu ajajeera; kunis dhimmichi duula filannoo keessatti akka hin fayyadamneef kan godhame dha. Manneen jireenyaa 1,200 ol of keessatti qabatu kun, sochii ummata Falasxiin kan gufachiisuu fi furmaata biyyoota lamaa kan miidhu waan ta'eef gadda addunyaa kaaseera. Karoorri kun nageenya naannichaa kan boorreesuu fi walitti bu'iinsa dabaluu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: Settlers smash cars, damage ambulance in West Bank village
english: Israeli settlers raided the West Bank village of al-Mughayyir, damaging vehicles and an ambulance while stealing farm equipment. Witnesses and reports state that these attacks occurred while Israeli security forces remained present and provided protection to the attackers. During the incident, soldiers also searched homes, fired tear gas, and temporarily held local residents at the village entrance.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በአል-ሙጋዪር መንደር በደረሱበት ጥቃት የሰዎችን መኪናዎች፣ አምቡላንስ እና የግብርና መሳሪያዎች አውድመዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ጥበቃ እና ፊት ለፊት መፈጸሙን የዓይን እማኞች ገልጸዋል። በዚሁ ወቅት ወታደሮቹ የአካባቢውን ነዋሪዎች ቤቶች በመበርበር እና እንባ አፋሽ ጋዝ በመተኮስ በዜጎች ላይ እንግልት ፈጽመዋል።
oromo: Warra biyya Israa'el kan ta'an kanneen qubatanii jiran ganda Al-Mughayyir jedhamu keessatti konkolaattota, ambulaansii fi meeshaalee qonnaa mancaasanii jiru. Miidhaan kun kan raawwatame poolisoonni Israa'el achuma jiranuun eegumsa gochaa akka turan gabaasni ni mul'isa. Yeroo kana keessa, loltoonni Israa'el mana jireenyaa sakatta'uudhaan, gaazii imimmaansuu darbachuudhaan fi namoota nagaa yeroodhaaf qabuudhaan miidhaa geessisanii jiru.

title: Musician Rob Del Naja arrested for 'I support Palestine Action' message
english: Massive Attack musician Rob Del Naja was arrested by UK police outside the Labour Party Conference for displaying a sign in support of Palestine Action. Authorities took this action because the government recently labeled the group a terrorist organization under national security laws. Del Naja rejected the legitimacy of the charges, while supporters have criticized the arrest and pledged to hold further demonstrations in his honor.
amharic: የማሲቭ አታክ የሙዚቃ ቡድን አባል የሆነው ሮብ ዴል ናጃ በሊቨርፑል በተካሄደው የሌበር ፓርቲ ጉባኤ ላይ ፍልስጤምን የሚደግፍ ምልክት በመያዙ በፖሊስ ተይዟል። የብሪታንያ መንግሥት 'ፓለስታይን አክሽን' የተባለውን ቡድን በአሸባሪነት በመፈረጁ፣ የሙዚቃ ባለሙያው በሽብርተኝነት ህግ ተከሷል። ዴል ናጃ የቀረበበትን ክስ እንደማይቀበል የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ደጋፊዎቹ ይህንን እስር በመቃወም ተጨማሪ ሰልፎችን እንደሚያደርጉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Artistii garee Massive Attack kan ta'e Rob Del Naja, magaalaa Liverpoolitti walga'ii Paartii Labour irratti mallattoo deeggarsa Palestine Action qabatee argamuun isaa poolisiin UK'n qabame. Mootummaan UK garee kana seera shororkeessummaan waan ramadeef, artistichi seeruma kanaan himatameera. Del Naja himata irratti dhiyaate kan hin fudhanne ta'uu ibsee, gartuun isaa immoo tarkaanfii kana balaaleffachuun guyyoota dhufanitti hiriira biroo akka taasisan ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli strike injures several displaced people in Gaza
english: An Israeli air strike targeted a tent sheltering displaced individuals in the Sheikh Radwan area of northern Gaza City. Multiple people sustained injuries as a result of the attack. Reports of the incident have been confirmed by local media sources.
amharic: የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በሰሜን ጋዛ ከተማ በሚገኘው የሼክ ረድዋን ሰፈር ተፈናቃዮች ተጠልለውበት በነበረ ድንኳን ላይ ተፈጽሟል። በዚህ ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የአካባቢው መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት የጥቃቱ ሁኔታ በምስል እና በቪዲዮ መረጃ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Humni qilleensa Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaa kaabaa ganda Sheikh Radwaanitti bakka buqqaatonni keessa jiraatan reebdee jirti. Miidhaa qaqqabe kanaan namoonni hedduun madaa'aniiru. Gabaasni miidiyaaleen naannichaa akka ibsanitti, rakkoon kun namoota heddutti miidhaa geessiseera.

title: Israeli forces carry out ‘violent explosions’ near southern Lebanon’s Khiam
english: The Israeli military conducted several powerful explosions near the town of Khiam, located along the southern border of Lebanon. This incident was officially reported by Lebanon's National News Agency. These military actions highlight the ongoing tensions occurring in the border region between the two countries.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በሊባኖስ ደቡባዊ ድንበር አቅራቢያ በምትገኘው በኪያም ከተማ አካባቢ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎችን አድርሷል። ይህንን ክስተት የሊባኖስ ብሔራዊ የዜና አገልግሎት በይፋ አረጋግጧል። እነዚህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች በሁለቱ አገራት ድንበር አካባቢ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ውጥረት ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Warri Israa'el daangaa Kibba Liibaanoos irra jirtu magaalaa Khiyaam biratti dhooksaa cimaa gaggeessaniiru. Taatee kana dhaabbanni oduu biyyaalessaa Liibaanoos gabaaseera. Gochi waraanaa kun walitti bu'iinsa daangaa biyyoota lamaan gidduutti uumamee jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Nor'easter brings flooding as New York and New Jersey declare emergency
english: A powerful nor'easter storm is striking the northeastern United States, causing severe coastal flooding, widespread power outages, and major travel disruptions. Both New York and New Jersey have officially declared states of emergency as authorities warn residents to avoid unnecessary travel and stay clear of floodwaters. Due to the dangerous winds and heavy rain, thousands of flights have been grounded and numerous public events, including concerts and sports games, have been cancelled.
amharic: ኃይለኛ የክረምት ማዕበል በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ሰሜናዊ ምስራቅ ክፍሎች በመከሰቱ ከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ፣ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ እና የጉዞ መስተጓጎል አስከትሏል። በኒውዮርክ እና በኒው ጀርሲ ግዛቶች የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ የታወጀ ሲሆን፣ ባለሥልጣናት ነዋሪዎች ከጎርፍ አደጋ እንዲርቁ እና አስፈላጊ ካልሆነ በስተቀር ከመንገድ እንዲቆጠቡ አስጠንቅቀዋል። በከፍተኛ ነፋስ እና በዝናብ ምክንያት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ በረራዎች ተሰርዘዋል እንዲሁም በርካታ የህዝብ ዝግጅቶች እና የስፖርት ውድድሮች ለሌላ ጊዜ ተላልፈዋል።
oromo: Bubbee cimaa gara kaaba-baha Ameerikaatti dhufeen, lolaan guddaan, humna elektirikii addaan cituu fi geejjibni addaan cituu uumameera. Mootummoonni Niiw Yoorkii fi Niiw Jeersii haala ariifachiisaa labsuun, jiraattoonni bakka lolaa irraa akka fagaatan fi imala barbaachisaa hin taane akka dhiisan gorsa kennaniiru. Bubbee fi rooba cimaa kanaan walqabatee, balalliiwwan kumaan lakkaa'aman haquun, akkasumas sagantaaleen uummataa fi taphoonni ispoortii hedduun addaan citaniiru.

title: Trump says he is rolling back Biden-era US fuel economy rules for cars
english: President Donald Trump has announced plans to reverse fuel efficiency standards established during the Biden administration. He aims to eliminate what he describes as an electric vehicle mandate, claiming these changes will reduce manufacturing costs and make new cars more affordable for families. This move marks a significant departure from previous policies that encouraged the production of low-emission vehicles to address climate change.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በባይደን አስተዳደር ወቅት የተጣሉትን የነዳጅ ቆጣቢነት መመዘኛዎች እንደሚቀይሩ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የኤሌክትሪክ ተሽከርካሪዎችን ለማበረታታት የወጡ ህጎችን በማስቀረት፣ የመኪና ዋጋን እንደሚቀንስ እና ለዜጎች እፎይታ እንደሚሰጥ ተናግረዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥን ለመቋቋም ቀደም ሲል ተዘርግተው የነበሩ የፖሊሲ ማዕቀፎችን የሚቀለብስ ትልቅ ለውጥ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaald Tiraamp sirreeffama qulqullina fi qusannoo boba'aa kan mootummaa Baayiden duraan tumame akka haqu beeksisaniiru. Tarkaanfichi ajaja konkolaataa elektirikii fayyadamuu akka haquufi gatiin konkolaataas akka hir'atu kan taasisu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Gochi kun rakkoo jijjiirama qilleensaa ittisuufi konkolaataa boba'aa xiqqoo gubatan babal'isuuf imaammata kanaan dura ture kan jijjiiruudha.

title: Yamal nets in Spain’s 3-2 comeback win against England in Nations League
english: Spain defeated England 3-2 in a Nations League match, maintaining their remarkable 39-game unbeaten streak. Although England took a lead following Lamine Yamal's opening goal and a missed penalty by Harry Kane, Spain capitalized on defensive errors to secure the comeback victory. This result marks another loss for England against the reigning world champions.
amharic: ስፔን በእንግሊዝ ላይ 3 ለ 2 በሆነ ውጤት በማሸነፍ የ39 ጨዋታዎች ያለመሸነፍ ክብረ ወሰኗን አስቀጥላለች። ላሚን ያማል መሪውን ግብ ቢያስቆጥርም እንግሊዝ መሪነቱን ወስዳ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ሃሪ ኬን የፍጹም ቅጣት ምት በመሳቱ እና የእንግሊዝ የተከላካይ ክፍል ባሳየው ስህተት ስፔን ወደ ጨዋታው በመመለስ አሸንፋለች። ይህ ውጤት የዓለም ሻምፒዮኗን ስፔን ብርታት ያሳየበት ሆኗል።
oromo: Ispeeniin tapha Nations League irratti Ingilizii 3-2 kan injifatte yoo ta'u, rekardii tapha 39 osoo hin injifatamin itti fufuun ishee mirkaneessiteetti. Lamine Yamal goolii jalqabaa erga galchee booda Ingiliiziin dursuu dandeesse turte, ta'us Harry Kane penaaltii waan badeef fi dogoggora ittisaa Ingiliiz irraa uumame fayyadamuun Ispeeniin injifannoo ishee gonfatteetti. Injifannoon kun gadi jabeessitee injifatattuu addunyaa ta'uu Ispeeniin kan agarsiise dha.

title: Russia scales up strikes on Ukraine as largest steelmaker halts operations
english: Russian forces have launched an intensified series of attacks across multiple regions of Ukraine. In response to the growing danger, ArcelorMittal has shut down its massive steel plant in Kryvyi Rih. The company cited safety concerns for its workers as the reason for suspending all facility operations.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በዩክሬን የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ ጥቃታቸውን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል። በዚህም ሳቢያ አርሴሎር ሚታል የተባለው ትልቅ የብረታ ብረት ፋብሪካ በክሪቪ ሪህ የሚገኘውን ቅርንጫፉን በጊዜያዊነት ዘግቷል። ኩባንያው ስራውን ያቆመው ለሰራተኞቹ ደህንነት ሲባል ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa naannolee Yuukreen garaa garaa irratti haleellaa cimaa gaggeessaa jiru. Balaa kana hordofee, dhaabbatni sibiilaa guddichi ArcelorMittal jedhamu, qulqullina sibiilaa magaalota Kirivii Rihi keessatti oomishu dhaabeera. Dhaabbatichi hojii isaa kan dhaabe ogeeyyiin isaa miidhaa irraa akka oolaniif yaadamee ti.

title: Why is violence between Pakistan and Afghanistan recurring?
english: Tensions between Pakistan and Afghanistan have escalated, leading to recent military strikes following a breakdown in their relationship. Although Islamabad initially supported the Taliban's 2021 return to power, relations have soured over accusations that Kabul is protecting militant groups launching attacks inside Pakistan. Afghanistan denies these claims, and ongoing efforts to resolve the cycle of violence between the two neighbors have not yet succeeded.
amharic: በፓኪስታን እና በአፍጋኒስታን መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት በመበላሸቱ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ግጭቶች ተባብሰዋል። ኢስላማባድ የጣሊባንን ወደ ስልጣን መምጣት በመጀመሪያ ብትደግፍም፣ አሁን ግን ካቡል በፓኪስታን ውስጥ ጥቃት የሚፈጽሙ ታጣቂ ቡድኖችን እያስተናገደች ነው በሚል ውዝግብ ተፈጥሯል። አፍጋኒስታን እነዚህን ክሶች ውድቅ የምታደርግ ሲሆን፣ ግጭቱን በሰላማዊ መንገድ ለመፍታት የተደረጉ ጥረቶች እስካሁን ስኬታማ አልሆኑም።
oromo: Hariiroon Paakistaanii fi Afgaanistaan gidduu jiru hammaachuu isaa hordofee, waraanni fi walitti bu'iinsi haaraan lamaan isaanii gidduutti uumameera. Paakistaan mootummaan Afgaanistaan garee hidhattootaa kanneen biyya ishee keessatti haleellaa raawwataniif bakka buusaa jirti jechuun himatti, garuu Afgaanistaan himata kana ni haalti. Jidduu seenuun nageenya buusuuf yaaliin godhame hundi hanga ammaatti milkaa'uu hin dandeenye.

title: Hamas slams Board of Peace for refusal to work with UNRWA in Gaza
english: Hamas has criticized the Board of Peace for refusing to collaborate with UNRWA in Gaza, labeling the decision as a biased move that mirrors Israeli policy. The Board of Peace claimed that UNRWA is not a reliable partner, though some officials privately suggested they have continued to interact with the agency. This controversy highlights the ongoing tension over UNRWA's future, as Palestinians rely on the agency for essential services and as a symbol of their right to return.
amharic: ሃማስ በጋዛ የሰላም ቦርድ ከዩኤንአርደብሊውኤ (UNRWA) ጋር ለመስራት ፈቃደኛ አለመሆኑን በማውገዝ፣ ይህ ውሳኔ ከእስራኤል አቋም ጋር የተጣጣመ ነው ሲል ከሷል። የሰላም ቦርዱ ድርጅቱ ታማኝ አይደለም በማለት የራሱን አቋም ቢገልጽም፣ በስተጀርባ ግን ከዩኤንአርደብሊውኤ ጋር ግንኙነት እንደነበራቸው ተነግሯል። ይህ አለመግባባት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞች መብትና እርዳታን የሚደግፈው የዩኤንአርደብሊውኤ የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ ምን እንደሚሆን አከራካሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Hamaas 'Board of Peace' jedhamu gargaarsa UNRWA (dhaabbata gargaarsa baqattoota Falasxiin) Gaza keessatti akka hin fayyadamne murteessuu isaa balaaleffateera. Hamaas murtoon kun Israa'el gargaarsa Falasxiin akka dhaabdu fi mirga deebii baqattootaa akka ukkaamsituuf gargaaruu dha jedheera. Board of Peace-n UNRWA irratti amanannaa akka hin qabne ibsus, garuu iccitidhaan dhaabbaticha waliin hojjechaa akka turan gabaasni ni mul'isa. Falasxiinonni dhaabbatichi dhimma ijoo jireenyaa fi mirga isaanii waan ta'eef, dhiibbaan irratti godhamu kun rakkoo cimaa akka uume dubbatu.

title: Iran says awaiting response through mediators after Trump reaction to proposal
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Tehran is currently waiting for a formal response from the United States regarding a recent proposal. While they have noted an initial reaction from President Donald Trump, they are expecting mediators to deliver a definitive official stance. Iran intends to evaluate this forthcoming information before deciding on its next steps.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ እንዳስታወቁት፣ ኢራን በአሜሪካ የቀረበለትን ሃሳብ በተመለከተ ከአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የመጀመሪያ ምላሽ ብታይም፣ መደበኛውን ምላሽ ግን ገና አልተቀበለችም። አገሪቱ መካከለኞች የአሜሪካን የመጨረሻ አቋም እስኪያሳውቋት ድረስ በትዕግስት እየጠበቀች ትገኛለች። ኢራን ቀጣዩን እርምጃ የምትወስነው እነዚህን መረጃዎች ከመረመረች በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Iraan Abbas Araagchii akka jedhanitti, Iraan dhiyeessa ishee irratti deebii mootummaa Ameerikaa irraa eeggachaa jirti. Prezidaant Doolald Tiraamp irraa yaada jalqabaa dhagahus, hanga ammaatti karaa giddu-galeessotaa deebii murtaa'aa ta'e hin arganne. Iraan tarkaanfii itti aanu fudhachuuf deebii dhumaa giddu-galeessota irraa dhufu kana akka eeggattu ibsameera.

title: Iran warns of restrictions on ships using unauthorised Hormuz routes
english: Iranian authorities have announced that vessels navigating the Strait of Hormuz will face strict penalties if they deviate from approved shipping lanes. This declaration follows US President Donald Trump’s refusal of an offer from Iran to normalize relations and reopen the waterway. Consequently, tensions remain high regarding the movement of ships through this critical maritime passage.
amharic: የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በሆርሙዝ ባህር ላይ በተፈቀዱ የጉዞ መስመሮች ውጪ የሚንቀሳቀሱ መርከቦች ከባድ ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቃቸው አስታውቀዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኢራን ግንኙነትን ለማደስ እና የባህር መተላለፊያውን ለመክፈት ያቀረበችውን ጥያቄ ውድቅ ካደረጉ በኋላ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት በወሳኙ የባህር መስመር ላይ ያለው ውጥረት አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Hoji-geeyyonni Iran akka ibsanitti, markeewwan daandii seeraan hayyamame ala Hormuz keessatti socho'an irratti tarkaanfiin cimaan kan fudhatamu ta'a. Ibsi kun kan dhufe erga pirezidaantiin Amerikaa Doonald Tiraamp dhiyeessa Iran kan hariiroo fooyyeessuu fi daandii galaana sana banuuf dhiyaate didanii boodadha. Kanaafuu, sochiin markeewwan daandii barbaachisaa ta'e kana keessatti taasifamu ammas yaaddoo keessa jira.

title: Pezeshkian says US and Israel are trying to pit countries against each other
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has urged Muslim nations to unite and avoid internal conflicts. He claimed that the United States and Israel are intentionally creating divisions among countries in the region. Upon returning from the UN General Assembly, he criticized these nations for ignoring international law and committing injustices against the Iranian people.
amharic: የኢራኑ ፕሬዝዳንት መስኡድ پزشکیያን የእስልምና ሀገራት ተባብረው በውስጣዊ ግጭት ከመጠመድ እንዲቆጠቡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል በክልሉ ያሉ ሀገራትን እርስ በእርስ በማጋጨት ለመከፋፈል እንደሚሰሩ ተናግረዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤን አጠናቀው ወደ ሀገራቸው እንደተመለሱም፣ እነዚህ ሀገራት አለም አቀፍ ህግን በመጣስ በኢራን ህዝብ ላይ በደል እየፈጸሙ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masoud Pezeshkian biyyooti Islaamaa tokkummaa uumanii walitti bu'iinsa keessoo irraa akka of qusatan dhaamaniiru. Ameerikaa fi Israa'el naannichatti biyyoota gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa uumuuf karoorfatanii akka hojjechaa jiran himaniiru. Gabaasa Walga'ii Waliigalaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii booda gara biyyattii yeroo deebi'an, biyyooti kunneen seera idil-addunyaa cabsuudhaan ummata Iraan irratti miidhaa geessisaa jiraachuu isaanii balleesaniiru.

title: Oman calls for "restraint" and dialogue in the Middle East conflict
english: Oman's Foreign Minister has urged all sides involved in Middle East tensions to practice restraint and pursue peaceful dialogue to reach lasting political solutions. Speaking at the United Nations, he also expressed his nation's ongoing dedication to ensuring safe navigation through the Strait of Hormuz. This statement follows the rejection of an Iranian truce proposal by U.S. leadership.
amharic: የኦማን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ለተፈጠረው ግጭት ሁሉም ወገኖች መረጋጋትን እንዲመርጡና በውይይት ዘላቂ መፍትሄ እንዲያመጡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ እንደተናገሩት፣ ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የባህር ጉዞ ደህንነትን ለመጠበቅ ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ጥሪ የተሰማው የአሜሪካ መንግስት ኢራን ያቀረበችውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ውድቅ ካደረገች በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Omaan walitti bu'iinsa Baha Giddu galeessaa keessatti hirmaatan hundi of qabuun mariin rakkoo isaanii akka hiikan waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Ejjennoo isaanii kan ibsan dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti yoo ta'u, Omaan karaa galaana Ormuz nagaya eeguuf kutannoo qabdu irra deebi'anii mirkaneessaniiru. Waamichi kun kan dhufe erga mootummaan Ameerikaa yaada waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa kan Iraan dhiyeessite diddee boodadha.

title: Hamas leader says Israel to use Gaza 'blood' in election
english: A senior Hamas official has dismissed the impact of Israel's upcoming elections, arguing that all Israeli political factions are equally responsible for Palestinian suffering. He expressed strong opposition to Palestinian lives being used as a political tool for campaign rhetoric. Ultimately, he emphasized that the group remains focused on achieving Palestinian rights rather than political shifts within Israel.
amharic: የሀማስ ከፍተኛ አመራር የእስራኤልን መጪ ምርጫ የፍልስጤማውያንን ችግር ለመፍታት ምንም ለውጥ አያመጣም ሲሉ አጣጥለውታል። የፍልስጤም ህዝብ ስቃይ ለምርጫ ቅስቀሳ እንደ መሳርያ እንዲውል እንደማይፈቅዱም ገልጸዋል። ከዚህ ይልቅ ትኩረታቸው የፍልስጤም ህዝብ መብቶችን እና ግቦችን ማስጠበቅ ላይ ብቻ እንደሆነ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata Hamaas akka jedhutti, filannoon Israa'el dhufu furmaata rakkoo ummata Filisxeemii fiduu hin danda'u. Hojiin siyaasaa Israa'el hundi rakkoo ummata isaanii kan hammeessan malee jijjiirama kan hin fidne ta'uu ibseera. Kanaafuu, dhiigni ummata Filisxeemii injifannoo siyaasaa argachuuf kan itti fayyadaman ta'uu akka hin qabne dubbateera.

title: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims
english: The German town of Heidenau has sparked significant controversy by voting to ban 'stumbling stone' memorials, which are brass plaques placed on streets to honor Nazi victims. Local councillors argued these memorials should be moved to a cemetery to prevent people from walking on them. However, critics and political figures have condemned the decision, describing it as an attempt to make the memory of victims invisible and a failure to properly acknowledge history.
amharic: የጀርመኗ ሀይደናው ከተማ በናዚ ሰለባዎች መታሰቢያነት በመንገድ ላይ የሚቀመጡ የናስ ንጣፎችን መከልከሏ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል። የከተማው አስተዳደር እነዚህን መታሰቢያዎች ሰዎች እንዳይረግጧቸው ወደ መቃብር ቦታ ማዛወር እንዳለባቸው ቢገልጽም፣ ውሳኔው ታሪክን የሚሽር እና የሰለባዎችን መታሰቢያ ከሕዝብ እይታ የሚያርቅ ነው በሚል ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው። ታዋቂ ሰዎችና የፖለቲካ ተንታኞችም ይህ አካሄድ የናዚ ሰለባዎችን መታሰቢያ በሕዝብ ቦታዎች ላይ የመጠበቅን አስፈላጊነት ችላ ያለ ነው ብለዋል።
oromo: Magaalaan Heidenau jedhamtuu kan Jarmanii, yaadannoo namoota Naaziin ajjeefamanif ganda keessatti kaayyaman kanneen 'stumbling stone' jedhaman dhorkuun ishee mormii guddaa kaaseera. Abbootiin taayitaa magaalaa kun yaadannoo kana namoonni irra hin ejjetneef gara iddoo awwaalchaatti jijjiiruu akka qaban dubbataniiru. Haa ta'u malee, qeeqtonniifi namoonni beekamoon murtii kana akka yaadatama dhugaa namoota miidhamanii dhoksuufi seenaa dagachuu akka ta'etti ibsanii jiru.

title: Saudi FM accuses Iran of ‘flagrant attacks’ and condemns Houthis at UNGA
english: During his speech at the UN General Assembly, the Saudi Arabian Foreign Minister criticized Iran for conducting direct attacks against civilian and economic sites in the Middle East. He also urged the global community to take a firm stance against the Houthi rebels due to their ongoing threats to international shipping in the Red Sea. Saudi Arabia emphasized the need for collective action to ensure regional stability and security.
amharic: የሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ባደረጉት ንግግር ኢራን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ በሚገኙ የሲቪል እና የኢኮኖሚ ተቋማት ላይ ጥቃት እያደረሰች ነው በማለት ከሰዋል። በተጨማሪም የሁቲ አማጽያን በቀይ ባህር የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ የሚያደርሱትን ስጋት በመቃወም ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የክልሉን ሰላምና ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ የጋራ ጥረት እንደሚያስፈልግ አጽንኦት ሰጥታለች።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Sa'udii Arabaa walga'ii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaarratti yoo dubbatan, Iraan naannichatti iddoowwan hawaasaa fi dinagdee irratti haleellaa raawwachaa jirti jechuun himatan. Gama biraan, gareen Huutii galaana diimaa keessatti markaboota daldalaa irratti sodaachisa raawwachaa jiru irratti hawaasni addunyaa tarkaanfii akka fudhatu gaafataniiru. Sa'udiin nageenya naannichaa mirkaneessuuf walta'iinsi addunyaa murteessaa ta'uu isaa ibsiteetti.

title: Ireland decide to play Israel in Nations League after squad vote
english: The Irish national football team has voted to proceed with their upcoming Nations League match against Israel. This decision followed discussions after one player considered withdrawing from the game. To address the humanitarian situation, the team plans to wear black armbands as a mark of respect for those who have died in the conflict.

oromo: Garee kubbaa miillaa biyyoolessa Ayirland tapha 'Nations League' kan dhufu irratti Isiraa'el wajjin taphachuuf sagalee kennuun murteessaniiru. Murteen kun kan darbe, taphataan tokko tapha kana irraa of baasuuf yaada qabaachuu isaa hordofee marii godhame booda dha. Gareen kun haleellaa fi waraana Gaza keessatti lubbuun darbeef kabaja agarsiisuuf, tapha irratti harka isaanii irratti marsaa gurraacha hidhachuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Lavrov: Russia’s war in Ukraine will continue ‘through to the end’
english: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov declared at the United Nations General Assembly that Russia will persist with its military campaign in Ukraine until all its goals are met. He described the ongoing invasion as a pursuit of truth and justice. This statement confirms that Moscow intends to continue the war until a final resolution is achieved on its own terms.
amharic: የሩሲያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሰርጌይ ላቭሮቭ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ እንደተናገሩት ሩሲያ በዩክሬን የጀመረችውን ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ግቦቿ እስኪሳኩ ድረስ እንደሚቀጥል ገልጸዋል። ይህንን ጦርነት ለእውነትና ለፍትህ የሚደረግ ትግል ሲሉ የገለጹት ሚኒስትሩ፣ ሞስኮ እስከ መጨረሻው ድረስ እንደሚገፋበት አረጋግጠዋል። በዚሁ መሰረት ሩሲያ ጦርነቱን ለማቆም ምንም አይነት ፍላጎት እንደሌላት ማሳያ ሆኗል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Raashiyaa Sergeey Laavroov Walga'ii Waliigalaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniirratti akka ibsanitti, Raashiyaan waraana Yukreenii irratti banatte galmaan gahuuf hamma dhumaatti akka itti fuftu beeksisaniiru. Hojii waraanaa kana dhugaa fi haqaaf kan godhamu jechuun, Moskoon kaayyoo ishee guututti akka hin galmaanetti duubatti akka hin deebine ibsaniiru. Ibsi kunis mootummaan Raashiyaa waraana kana xumuraan milkeessuuf murteeffachuu isaa kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Colombia extradites leader of armed group to US in shift towards Washington
english: Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella has extradited alleged drug trafficking leader Geovany Andres Rojas to the United States. This move marks a major policy shift, as the current administration abandons the previous government's negotiation-based approach in favor of military action and stronger cooperation with Washington. Rojas, who led a splinter group of former FARC rebels, will now face terrorism and drug trafficking charges in a California court.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያው ፕሬዚዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪዬላ፣ አደንዛዥ ዕፅ አዘዋዋሪ ነው የተባለውን ጂዮቫኒ አንድሬስ ሮሃስን ወደ አሜሪካ አሳልፈው ሰጥተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የቀድሞው መንግስት በድርድር ይከተል የነበረውን ስልት በመተው፣ አሁን ያለው አስተዳደር በወታደራዊ እርምጃ እና ከአሜሪካ ጋር በቅርበት በመስራት ላይ ያተኮረ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ ማድረጉን ያሳያል። የቀድሞ የፋርክ ታጣቂዎች ቡድን አባል የነበረው ሮሃስ፣ በአሜሪካ ፍርድ ቤት በሽብርተኝነት እና በአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር ወንጀል ክስ ይመሰረትበታል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Kolombiyaa Abeelardoo de la Eespiriyeellaan, hogganaa garee seeraan alaa fi qabiinsa qoricha sammuu hadoochuu kessatti shakkame jiyoovanii Anndirees Roohaas gara Yunaayitid Isteetsitti erganiiru. Tarkaanfin kun jijjiirama siyaasaa guddaa kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, mootummaan ammaa karaa marii furmaata barbaaduu dhiisee, humna waraanaa fi hariiroo Yunaayitid Isteets waliin qabu cimsuu filateera. Roohaas, miseensa garee fkn (FARC) duraanii kan ture, amma gara biyyaatti eramee himannaa shororkeessummaa fi daldala qoricha sammuu hadoochuu irratti qabaata.

title: South African police discover body of 10th woman near Johannesburg
english: South African police have recovered the tenth female body found near Johannesburg since mid-July. Authorities are investigating these deaths amidst growing public alarm over the nation's extreme rates of violence against women. While officials are determining if the incidents are linked, high-level investigators have been assigned to the case to identify those responsible.
amharic: የደቡብ አፍሪካ ፖሊስ ከሐምሌ ወር አጋማሽ ጀምሮ በጆሃንስበርግ አካባቢ የተገኘ አስረኛውን የሴት አስከሬን አግኝቷል። በአገሪቱ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የሴቶች ላይ ጥቃት ተከትሎ ባለሥልጣናት ግድያዎቹ እርስ በርስ የተያያዙ መሆናቸውን እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ። መንግሥት ለጉዳዩ ቅድሚያ በመስጠት ወንጀለኞቹን ለፍርድ ለማቅረብ ከፍተኛ መርማሪዎችን መድቧል።
oromo: Poolisiin Afrikaa Kibbaa baatii Waxabajjii irraa eegalee naannoo magaalaa Joohaanisbargitti reeffa dubartii kurnaffaa argateera. Qondaaltonni mootummaa ajjeechaan kunneen walitti hidhata qabaachuu fi dhabuu isaanii qulqulleessuuf qorattoota dandeettii qaban ramadanii hojjechaa jiru.

title: Gaza death toll rises
english: The Palestinian Ministry of Health reports that seven more people have died and 38 were injured in Gaza over the last two days. These figures add to the ongoing toll since the conflict began in October 2023, which has now reached over 74,000 deaths. Since the October 2025 ceasefire, authorities have documented more than 1,400 additional fatalities in the region.
amharic: የፍልስጤም የጤና ሚኒስቴር እንዳስታወቀው ባለፉት ሁለት ቀናት በጋዛ ሰባት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ 38 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ በተቀሰቀሰው ግጭት የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ74,000 በላይ ደርሷል። በጥቅምት 2025 ከተደረገው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ ብቻ ከ1,400 በላይ ሰዎች መገደላቸውን ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri Fayyaa Falasxiin akka gabaasetti, guyyoota lamaan darban keessa Gaazaatti namoonni torba du'aniiru, 38 immoo madaa'aniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi Sadaasa 2023 eegale namoota 74,000 ol galaafateera. Onkololeessa 2025 waldhabbiin erga dhaabbate asitti, namoonni 1,400 ol ta'an ajjeefamuu isaanii qorannoon ni agarsiisa.

title: Iraq says US agrees to continue cash dollar shipments
english: The Iraqi government announced that it has reached an agreement with the United States to keep delivering physical cash dollars to the country. These shipments had faced interruptions earlier this year, but a new supply of cash is expected to arrive shortly. This development marks a return to regular cooperation following a period of suspended transfers that began in April.
amharic: የኢራቅ መንግስት ከአሜሪካ ጋር በመነጋገር የዶላር ጥሬ ገንዘብ ዝውውር እንዲቀጥል ስምምነት ላይ መድረሱን አስታውቋል። ቀደም ሲል በነበረው የበርካታ ወራት እገዳ ምክንያት የገንዘብ አቅርቦቱ ተቋርጦ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በቀጣዮቹ ቀናት አዲስ የዶላር ጭነት እንደሚገባ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ስምምነት ካለፈው ሚያዝያ ወር ጀምሮ ተቋርጦ የነበረውን የገንዘብ ልውውጥ ሂደት ወደ ነበረበት ለመመለስ ታስቦ የተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraaq yeroo dhiyootti doolaara dhangala'aa Ameerikaarraa gara biyyatti erguu itti fufuuf walii galtee irra ga'uu isaa beeksiseera. Ergaa maallaqaa kana dura ji'oota hedduuf dhaabamee ture, garuu yeroo dhiyootti doolaarri haaraan biyyatti akka galu eegama. Walii galtuun kun ji'a Ebla darbe irraa jalqabee kan dhaabate ture yoo ta'u, amma deebi'ee itti fufuuf qophii ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: At UN, Saudi FM warns world failing to protect Gulf shipping
english: Saudi Arabia’s Foreign Minister recently urged the United Nations to take stronger action against the interference with shipping routes in the Middle East. He argued that Iranian-led disruptions in critical waterways like the Strait of Hormuz and the Bab al-Mandab Strait pose a significant danger to global energy supplies. The official called on the international community to fulfill its duty in ensuring safe and free navigation across these essential maritime passages.

title: Qatar rejects Netanyahu’s claims over anti-Israel campaign
english: Qatar has officially dismissed accusations from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that it is orchestrating a campaign to manipulate youth against Israel. Qatari officials stated that this rhetoric is merely a distraction from Israel's actions in Palestinian territories and the resulting humanitarian crisis. Furthermore, Qatar argued that the global shift in public opinion is driven by people witnessing current events directly, rather than external influence.
