oromo: Qatar himannaa ministirri muummee Israa'el Binyamin Netanyaahu dargaggoota Israa'el irratti kakaasuuf duula geggeessaa jirti jedhanii dhiyeessan gadi jabeessuun mormiteetti. Qataar akka ibsitetti, himannaan kun gocha mootummaan Israa'el naannolee Paalastaayinii keessatti raawwataa jiruufi miidhaa namoomaa isaa irraa xiyyeeffannoo dhibuuf kan uumamedha. Kana malees, jijjiiramni ilaalchaa addunyaa dhiibbaa alaa miti, garuu namoonni gochawwan amma raawwatamaa jiran ofii isaanii arguun kan murtii kennan ta'uu ibsiteetti.

title: Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says
english: An independent review of the 2025 shooting of activist Charlie Kirk at Utah Valley University found significant security failures in the event's planning. The report concluded that the university failed to conduct proper risk assessments and allowed the hosting organization, Turning Point USA, to override safety concerns regarding the outdoor venue. While investigators noted poor coordination between campus police and private security, they determined that no staff members acted with malicious intent.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2025 በዩታ ቫሊ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ስለተገደለው አክቲቪስት ቻርሊ ኪርክ የተደረገ ገለልተኛ ጥናት በዝግጅቱ አደረጃጀት ውስጥ ትልቅ የደህንነት ጉድለቶች እንደነበሩ አጋልጧል። ዩኒቨርሲቲው ተገቢውን የአደጋ ግምገማ ሳያደርግ ለዝግጅቱ አዘጋጆች ማለትም 'ተርኒንግ ፖይንት ዩኤስኤ' ለደህንነት ስጋቶች ቦታ እንዲሰጡ መፍቀዱ ተመልክቷል። የምርመራው ውጤት በዩኒቨርሲቲው ፖሊስ እና በግል የደህንነት ጠባቂዎች መካከል የተቀናጀ ስራ እንዳልነበረ ቢጠቁምም፣ የዩኒቨርሲቲው ሰራተኞች ሆን ብለው ጉዳት ለማድረስ አላሰቡም ብሏል።
oromo: Qorannoon bilisaa ajjeechaa aktivistii Chaarlie Kirk kan bara 2025 yuunivarsitii Yuuta Vaalii keessatti raawwatame irratti gaggeeffame, qophii sagantichaa keessatti hanqina nageenyaa gurguddaa akka ture ifa godheera. Gabaasichi yuunivarsitiin kun madaallii nageenyaa sirrii ta'e osoo hin gaggeessin, gurmuu saganticha qopheesseef iddoo alaatiif durii qaban akka hordofan heeyyama kennuusaanii ibseera. Qorattoonni poolisii yuunivarsitichaa fi eegdota dhuunfaa gidduutti walitti hidhamiinsi gaariin akka hin turre kan eeran yoo ta'u, hojjettoonni yuunivarsitichaa yaada hamaadhaan tarkaanfii fudhataniiru jedhee hin amanu.

title: Venezuelan government, opposition agree to work towards reform of top court
english: Venezuela’s interim government and opposition leaders have agreed to form a special committee to reform the country's Supreme Court. This collaborative panel will review the process for selecting judges as part of broader efforts to change the judicial system. While these talks mark a step toward political dialogue, critics note that major democratic reforms and election timelines remain uncertain under the current administration.

Mareen kun tarkaanfii gara marii siyaasaatti fudhatame ta'us, bulchiinsi ammaa kun jijjiirama cimaa fi yeroo filannoo ilaalchisee waadaa ifa ta'e akka hin galle komatamaa jira.

title: Women take up arms as sexual violence ravages eastern DRC
english: In the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, women are joining the pro-government Wazalendo militia to protect their families from ongoing conflict and sexual violence. Despite this shift, the militia is also being investigated for its own history of severe human rights violations. These women now find themselves in a precarious position as they fight alongside a group accused of perpetrating the very abuses they seek to escape.

Ta'us, gareen kun namoota irratti miidhaa gurguddaa fi ajjeechaa akkasumas dirqisiisuun wal qunnamtii saalaa raawwachuu dhaan himatameera. Dubartoonni kun miidhaa irraa of baraaruuf garee waraanaa kana keessatti hirmaatanis, gareen sun ofii isaatiin yakka raawwachuun shakkamuun haala ulfaataa keessa isaan galcheera.

title: At least 10 people killed in Russian and Ukrainian attacks
english: Recent cross-border attacks between Russia and Ukraine have resulted in the deaths of at least ten people. Russian strikes targeted various Ukrainian cities, including Zaporizhzhia and Sumy, while Ukrainian drone operations hit industrial sites and an oil refinery within Russian territory. Meanwhile, diplomatic tensions remain high as Moscow blames European nations for obstructing potential peace negotiations.

title: Jerusalem Daily: violence continues as the world watches the UNGA
english: As the United Nations General Assembly continues its sessions, world leaders are actively condemning ongoing Israeli military actions against Palestinians. Despite this international pressure, Israeli forces and settlers have maintained their strikes across the West Bank and Gaza. The situation remains tense as the global community watches these developments unfold.

title: Manchester City confident they can prove ‘innocence’ over charges: Chairman
english: Manchester City's chairman, Khaldoon Al Mubarak, has expressed strong confidence that the club will prove its innocence regarding 114 alleged breaches of Premier League financial regulations. While reports suggest an independent panel has found the club guilty, leadership insists the legal process is ongoing and plans to appeal the decision. The club maintains its long-standing stance that they have acted correctly and will rely on evidence to defend their position.
amharic: የማንቸስተር ሲቲ ሊቀመንበር ካልዱን አል ሙባረክ ክለቡ በፕሪሚየር ሊጉ የፋይናንስ ህጎች ላይ የፈፀመው የተባለውን 114 ጥሰቶች ክስ ውድቅ እንደሚያደርጉና ንፁህነታቸውን እንደሚያረጋግጡ ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል። ገለልተኛ አካላት በክለቡ ላይ የጥፋተኝነት ውሳኔ ማስተላለፋቸውን የሚገልጹ ዘገባዎች ቢኖሩም፣ ክለቡ ህጋዊ ሂደቱ አላለቀም በማለት ውሳኔውን ይግባኝ እንደሚጠይቁ አረጋግጠዋል። የክለቡ አመራሮች ከጅምሩ እንደገለጹት ሁሉ አሁንም በህጋዊ ማስረጃዎች ንፁህነታቸውን ለማረጋገጥ ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin kilabii Maanchastar Siitii Kaalduun Al Mubaarak, kilabichi seera maallaqaa Piriimiyar Liigii irra darbe jedhamuun himannaa 114 irratti dhiyaateef akka itti hin fayyadamneefi nagaa ta'uu isaa mirkaneessuuf abdiin akka qaban ibsaniiru. Koreen bilisa ta'e tokko kilabicha irratti murtee yakkaa dabarseera kan jedhu gabaasni yoo jiraateyyuu, hoogganoonni kilabichaa adeemsi seeraa amma iyyuu kan hin xumuramne ta'uu fi murtee kana irratti oliyyannoo akka dhiyeeffatan ibsaniiru. Kilabichi jalqaba irraayyuu gocha yakkaa kamiyyuu akka hin raawwanne amana, ragaalee qabanitti fayyadamuun falmachuufis murteeffataniiru.

title: Russia ready to help on Strait of Hormuz, Lavrov says
english: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov announced at the UN that Moscow is prepared to assist in stabilizing the Strait of Hormuz and the surrounding Gulf region. He emphasized the necessity of fostering trust between Iran and Arab nations to create a more secure regional framework. Russia intends to work with other nations to help resolve ongoing tensions in this vital area.
amharic: የሩሲያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሰርጌ ላቭሮቭ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ጉባኤ ላይ እንደተናገሩት ሞስኮ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት እና በአካባቢው ያለውን ውጥረት ለማረጋጋት ለመርዳት ዝግጁ መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። በኢራን እና በአረብ ሀገራት መካከል መተማመን መፈጠር የክልሉን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ ወሳኝ መሆኑን አሳስበዋል። ሩሲያም ከሌሎች ሀገራት ጋር በመተባበር በዚህ ስልታዊ አስፈላጊ ቀጠና ውስጥ ሰላምን ለማስፈን አስተዋጽኦ ለማድረግ እንደምትሻ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Raashiyaa Sergei Lavrov, Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii irratti akka ibsanitti, Raashiyaan naannoo Hormuz fi laga Goolfii keessatti tasgabbii uumuuf gargaaruuf qophii ta'uu ibsaniiru. Walitti buiinsa jiru furuuf biyyoota Goolfii fi Iraan gidduutti amanannaan uumamuun barbaachisaa ta'uu himaniiru. Raashiyaan biyyoota itti gaafatamummaa fudhatan biroo waliin ta'uun, naannoo kutaalee istiraatejii kana tasgabbeessuuf gumaacha gochuuf qophii dha.

title: Trump rejects Iranian proposal to open Hormuz and end war
english: President Donald Trump has turned down an offer from Iran to end regional hostilities and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Iran had proposed this plan through Qatari mediators during the UN General Assembly to address its economic struggles. Trump dismissed the offer, claiming that the U.S. is currently in a strong position and that Iran is only seeking a deal because of its financial difficulties.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን የቀረበላቸውን የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የመክፈቻ እና የጦርነት ማቆሚያ ጥያቄ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ኢራን ይህንን ሀሳብ በኳታር አደራዳሪዎች በኩል ያቀረበችው በኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ውስጥ በመሆኗ ነው። ትራምፕ በበኩላቸው አሜሪካ በአሁኑ ወቅት ጠንካራ አቋም ላይ እንደምትገኝ በመግለጽ የኢራንን ጥያቄ አልቀበልም ብለዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Doonaald Tiraamp dhiyeessa Iiraan kan karaa giddu-galeessa Qaaxar dhiyaateef fudhachuu didaniiru. Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, Iiraan kan rakkatteef dhiibbaa diinagdee irra gahuu waan ta'eef, Ameerikaan ammoo yeroo ammaa sadarkaa gaarii irra waan jirtuuf dhiyeessii kana hin fudhatu jedhaniiru.

title: Israeli gunfire kills child in Gaza
english: Israeli military forces fatally shot a child in the al-Mawasi area of Rafah, located in southern Gaza. This incident follows an earlier killing of a Palestinian man by Israeli troops in the Jabalia refugee camp in the north. Since the previous ceasefire, the total number of fatalities in the Gaza Strip has surpassed 1,400 people.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በደቡባዊ ጋዛ በሚገኘው ራፋህ በአል-መዋሲ አካባቢ አንድ ህጻን በጥይት መትተው ገድለዋል። ከዚህ ክስተት ቀደም ብሎም በሰሜናዊ ጋዛ በሚገኘው የጃባሊያ መጠለያ ካምፕ ውስጥ አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ በእስራኤል ኃይሎች ተገድሏል። ካለፈው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ በጋዛ ሰርጥ የተገደሉ ሰዎች ቁጥር ከ1,400 በላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda Rafah kan kibba Gaazaatti argamu al-Mawaasii keessatti ijoollee tokko rasaasaan rukutanii ajjeesaniiru. Kanaan dura, kaaba Gaazaatti kan argamu qubannaa baqattootaa Jaabaaliyaa keessatti namni Falasxiinii tokko humnoota Israa'eliin ajjeefameera. Walii galtee dhaabbii waraana darbee irraa jalqabee, lakkoofsi namoota Gaazaa keessatti ajjeefamanii 1,400 caaleera.

title: China pushes back against US on Iran and Cuba in UN speech
english: During the UN General Assembly, China's Vice President Han Zheng challenged American foreign policy without naming the country directly. He criticized the blockade against Cuba and emphasized the importance of respecting the sovereignty of Middle Eastern nations. These remarks highlight growing tensions despite recent diplomatic meetings between the two global powers.
amharic: በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ የቻይና ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ሃን ዠንግ አሜሪካን በቀጥታ ሳይጠሩ በውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲዋ ላይ ትችት ሰንዝረዋል። በኩባ ላይ የተጣለውን ማዕቀብ በመቃወም የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ሀገራት ሉዓላዊነት ሊከበር እንደሚገባ አሳስበዋል። ይህ ንግግር በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል በቅርቡ ከተደረጉ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቶች በተቃራኒ እየጨመረ የመጣውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Waltajjii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaatti, pirezidaantiin itti aanaa Chaayinaa Han Zheng maqaa dha'uu baatanis, imaammata alaa Ameerikaa irratti qeeqa dhiyeessaniiru. Qubaa irratti uggurtee jiru balaaleffachuun, biyyoonni Baha Giddu-galeessaa bilisummaan akka kabajamuuf gaafataniiru. Yaanni kun, biyyoota lamaan gidduutti wal arguun gaarii ta'us, rakkoon siyaasaa akka jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Haftar's forces execute 30 after secret military trials in eastern Libya
english: Forces led by Khalifa Haftar in eastern Libya have executed 30 prisoners following secretive military trials that rights groups claim were fundamentally unfair. These individuals were reportedly convicted using forced confessions obtained through torture, and at least 50 more people remain at risk of facing the same fate. International organizations have condemned these actions, demanding a halt to all executions and calling for the families to be allowed to properly bury their loved ones.
amharic: በምስራቅ ሊቢያ በካሊፋ ሃፍታር የሚመሩ ኃይሎች በድብቅ ወታደራዊ ችሎት የሞት ፍርድ የፈረዱባቸውን 30 እስረኞች አስገድለዋል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች እንደገለጹት፣ እነዚህ ፍርዶች በማሰቃየት በተገኙ የእምነት ቃላት ላይ የተመሰረቱ በመሆናቸው ፍትሃዊ አይደሉም። በተጨማሪም ቢያንስ 50 እስረኞች አሁንም ለተመሳሳይ የሞት ፍርድ አደጋ ተጋልጠዋል። አለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች ይህንን ድርጊት በማውገዝ ግድያው በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆም እና ቤተሰቦች የቀብር ሥነ-ሥርዓት እንዲፈጽሙ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Baha Liibiya keessatti loltoonni Khalifa Haftar hoogganaman, namoota 30 ta'an manni murtee waraanaa dhoksaa ta'een booda ajjeesaniiru. Gareewwan mirga namoomaa akka jedhanitti, murtiin kun kan darbe yakka wal-qabsiisuun dararaa qaamaa irraan ga'uun 'walgahi'i' akka kennan taasifamuu isaatiin ta'uu ibsaniiru. Namoonni gara 50 ta'anis yeroo dhihoo keessatti ajjeefamuuf sodaatamaa jiru. Dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa gocha kana balaaleffachuun, ajjeechaan kun hatattamaan dhaabbatee fi maatiin namoota ajjeefamanii reeffa isaanii akka sirnaan awwaallatan gaafataniiru.

title: Exam Reforms Aren’t Fixing Ethiopia’s Institutional Decay
english: Despite significant efforts to tighten security during national exams, Ethiopia’s education system continues to face deep-rooted moral and institutional challenges. While cheating on tests has decreased, the alarming failure rates suggest that students have not been adequately prepared to value honesty or critical thinking over shortcuts. Ultimately, the country's schools seem to be fostering a culture where results matter more than integrity, highlighting a broader decay in societal values.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ የፈተና አሰጣጥ ላይ የተደረጉ የደህንነት ማሻሻያዎች ቢኖሩም፣ የትምህርት ሥርዓቱ አሁንም ከባድ ተቋማዊ እና ስነ-ምግባራዊ ችግሮች አሉበት። በፈተና ወቅት የሚደረግ ማጭበርበር ቢቀንስም፣ እጅግ በጣም ዝቅተኛ የሆነው የተማሪዎች የማለፊያ ውጤት ትምህርት ቤቶች ስለ ታማኝነት እና ስለ እውነተኛ እውቀት ግንዛቤ የመፍጠር አቅማቸው ደካማ መሆኑን ያሳያል። በአጠቃላይ በትምህርት ቤቶች ውስጥ ውጤትን እንጂ ስነ-ምግባርን የማያስተምር የተደበቀ ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት በመኖሩ፣ ይህ የህብረተሰብ እሴት መሸርሸር አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል።

Qormaata irratti gowwoomsuun xiqqachuu danda'us, barattoonni baay'een qormaata darbuu dhabuun isaanii mana barnootaa keessatti amanamummaan ykn waa'ee dhugaatti xiyyeeffannoon akka hin kennamne agarsiisa. Walumaagalatti, manneen barnootaa hubannoo caalaatti qabxii qofa irratti xiyyeeffachuu barsiisuun isaanii, gatiin hawaasummaa akka laafu gochaa jira.

title: Huge crowds greet Pope in Paris for open-air Mass
english: Pope Leo XIV held a large open-air Mass in central Paris, drawing hundreds of thousands of supporters along the Champs-Élysées. The event included a procession through the city, though French President Emmanuel Macron opted not to attend to maintain the country's secular policies. During his four-day trip, the Pope also addressed issues such as the importance of supporting refugees, the vital role of women in society, and the potential risks posed by artificial intelligence.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በፓሪስ መሀል ከተማ በሻንዝ ኤሊዜ መንገድ ላይ ለሚገኙ በመቶ ሺዎች ለሚቆጠሩ ምዕመናን ትልቅ የሜዳ ላይ መስዋዕተ ቅዳሴ አድርሰዋል። የፈረንሳይ ፕሬዝዳንት ኢማኑኤል ማክሮን የሀገሪቱን የሃይማኖት እና የመንግስት መለያየት መርህ ለማክበር በስነ-ስርዓቱ ላይ አልተገኙም። ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳቱ በፈረንሳይ በቆዩባቸው አራት ቀናት ውስጥ ስደተኞችን መርዳት፣ የሴቶች ሚና እና የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) በሰው ልጅ ላይ ሊያመጣ ስለሚችለው ተጽዕኖ ሰፊ ንግግር አድርገዋል።
oromo: Pappaan Le'o kudha afurree (XIV) magaala Paaris keessatti uummata hedduu hirmaachise ayyaana misa qilleensa gubbaa irratti gaggeessaniiru. Preezdaantiin Faransaay Imaanu'eel Maakroon dhimma adda baasuun mootummaa fi amantii ilaalchisee ayyaanicha irratti hin argamne. Daawwannaa guyyaa afur kanneen keessatti, pappaan haala godaantotaa, gahee dubartootni qaban akkasumas guddinni teknoloojii 'artificial intelligence' dhala namaa irratti miidhaa geessisuu danda'u irratti gorsa kennaniiru.

title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens
english: A massive explosion, likely caused by a gas leak, destroyed a three-story residential building in the historic Plaka district of Athens, Greece. The tragic incident resulted in the deaths of six people, including a British citizen, four American tourists, and a local Greek resident. Emergency teams have recovered all the victims from the debris, which was scattered near major tourist landmarks like the Acropolis.
amharic: በግሪክ አቴንስ ታሪካዊው የፕላካ አካባቢ በደረሰ የጋዝ ፍንዳታ የተነሳ ባለ ሶስት ፎቅ ህንጻ ሙሉ በሙሉ በመውደሙ ስድስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል አንድ የብሪታንያ ዜጋ፣ አራት አሜሪካዊያን ቱሪስቶች እና አንድ ግሪካዊ ይገኙበታል። የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሰራተኞች ፍርስራሹን በመበርበር የተጎጂዎችን አስከሬን ያገገሙ ሲሆን፣ የከተማዋ ከንቲባ አደጋውን ከባድ ጥፋት ሲሉ ገልጸውታል።
oromo: Garee magaalaa Atenes, biyya Giriikitti iddoo seena-qabeessa kan ta'e Plaka jedhamutti, dhuka'a gaazii irraa ka'een mana gandaa guddina saddeetii qabu tokko guutummaatti barbadaa'eera. Balaa kanaan lammii Biriiteen tokko, tuuristoota Ameerikaa afur fi lammii Giriik tokko dabalatee namoonni jahaan lubbuun darbaniiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa firaasicha keessaa reeffa namoota miidhamanii hunda kan baasan yoo ta'u, balaan kun miidhaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: Egypt to rest Salah in South Sudan AFCON qualifier over pitch concerns
english: The Egyptian Football Association has decided to exclude Mohamed Salah from the upcoming AFCON qualifier match against South Sudan. This decision was made to prevent potential injuries, as the Juba Stadium features an artificial turf surface. Officials agreed on this precaution to protect the star player's health during the qualifying series.
amharic: የግብፅ እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን መሐመድ ሳላህ በደቡብ ሱዳን ከሚደረገው የአፍሪካ ዋንጫ ማጣሪያ ጨዋታ ውጪ እንዲሆን ወስኗል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው በጁባ ስታዲየም ያለው ሰው ሰራሽ ሜዳ ለጉዳት የመጋለጥ እድል ስላለው ተጫዋቹን ለመጠበቅ ነው። የቡድኑ አሰልጣኞች እና ተጫዋቹ የጉዳት ስጋትን ለመቀነስ በዚህ የጥንቃቄ እርምጃ ላይ ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Federeeshiniin kubbaa miilaa Gibxii Mohaammad Saalaah tapha guchii waancaa Afrikaa kan Sudaan Kibbaa waliin godhamu irratti akka hin hirmaanne murteesseera. Murtoon kun kan dabarfame taphni kun dirree marga namtolchee (artificial turf) irratti kan godhamuufi miidhaa irraa ittisuuf yaadameeti. Gareen biyyoolessaa Gibxii fi Saalaah of eeggannoo kana kan fudhatan miidhaa tasaa irraa qabxii taphataa eeguuf jechuudha.

title: The intelligence war is turning against the Houthis
english: The Houthi movement previously gained a significant battlefield advantage by utilizing integrated Russian satellite intelligence and Iranian command systems to target opponents in Yemen. However, this sophisticated surveillance network is now facing increased scrutiny and counter-efforts that are weakening its effectiveness. By analyzing how Russia provided geospatial and signals intelligence, experts have identified how these systems were used to coordinate precise military strikes.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን የነበራቸውን ወታደራዊ የበላይነት ያገኙት የሩስያ ሳተላይት መረጃዎችን እና የአይራን የትእዛዝ ስርዓትን በማቀናጀት ነበር። ይሁን እንጂ በአሁኑ ወቅት ይህ የተራቀቀ የስለላ መረብ ከፍተኛ ጥቃት እየደረሰበት በመሆኑ ውጤታማነቱ እየቀነሰ መጥቷል። ባለሙያዎች እንደገለጹት የሩስያ የጠፈር እና የሲግናል መረጃዎች ተቃዋሚዎችን ለማጥቃት እንዴት እንደተጠቀሙበት የተደረገው ክትትል የዚህን ስርዓት ሚስጥር አጋልጦታል።
oromo: Houthiin duraan fayyadama ragaalee saattalaayitaa Ruusiyaafi sirna ajaja Iraan walitti makuun iddoo waraanaatti faayidaa guddaa argachaa ture. Haata'u malee, sirni hordoffii kun ammaa kana irratti tarkaanfiin fudhatamaa waan jiruuf, humni isaa laafaa jira. Ogeeyyiin akka ibsanitti, mala Ruusiyaan ragaalee qilleensa irraa fi siiginaala walitti qabdee diina irratti itti fayyadamaa turte ifa baasuun, sirnichatti gufuu ta'aa jira.

title: Girl disabled by Israeli strike urges wheelchairs be let into Gaza
english: Eight-year-old Layan Asaliya, who lost her mobility due to an Israeli military strike in Gaza, is pleading with authorities to permit the delivery of wheelchairs into the territory. Many children who suffered amputations or injuries during the conflict are currently suffering because they cannot access these essential mobility aids. Israel continues to block the entry of these devices, leaving vulnerable young survivors without the support they desperately need.
amharic: በጋዛ በእስራኤል ጥቃት አካለ ስንኩልነት የገጠማት የ8 ዓመቷ ላያን አሳሊያ፣ ተሽከርካሪ ወንበሮች ወደ ጋዛ እንዲገቡ የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናትን ትለምናለች። በጦርነቱ ምክንያት እግራቸውን ላጡ ወይም ጉዳት ለደረሰባቸው ህጻናት ተሽከርካሪ ወንበር ማግኘት አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል። እስራኤል እነዚህን የህክምና መርጃ መሳሪያዎች ወደ ጋዛ እንዳይገቡ በመከልከሏ ምክንያት ህጻናቱ ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ወድቀዋል።
oromo: Mucaan waggaa saddeetii Layan Asaliyaa jedhamtu, haleellaa waraana Israa'el irra gaheen qaama hir'uuf taate, gargaarsa kuraa (wheelchair) gara Gaazaatti akka galan mootummaa Israa'el gaafatteetti. Ijoolleen waraana kanaan miidhamanii fi miila isaanii dhaban, meeshaalee sochiif gargaaran dhabuun rakkoo hamaa keessa jiru. Israa'el meeshaalee barbaachisoo ta'an kana akka hin galle dhowwuun ishee, ijoollee miidhamtota ta'an kana jireenya ulfaataa keessa buusteetti.

title: Turkiye calls for UN Security Council veto to end: Could it happen?
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has urged the United Nations to abolish the veto power held by its five permanent Security Council members, arguing that the current system is unfair and ineffective. He claims this structure prevents the council from addressing major global conflicts like those in Gaza and Ukraine. However, such a significant change is highly unlikely, as it would require the consent of the very nations that currently hold this powerful veto privilege.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ታይፕ ኤርዶغان የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የፀጥታው ምክር ቤት አምስት ቋሚ አባላት ያላቸውን የቪቶ መብት እንዲሰርዙ ጠይቀዋል። አሁን ያለው አሰራር ፍትሃዊ ባለመሆኑ እንደ ጋዛ እና ዩክሬን ያሉ ዓለም አቀፍ ግጭቶችን ለመፍታት እንቅፋት እየሆነ ነው ሲሉ ተከራክረዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ይህንን ስልጣን በያዙት አገራት ፈቃድ የሚከናወን በመሆኑ፣ ለውጡን እውን ማድረግ በጣም አስቸጋሪ እንደሆነ ይታመናል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Turkii Rajab Xayyib Erdogaan, miseensota dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti mana maree nageenyaa shanan murtii mormii (veto) kennuuf qaban akka haqan gaafataniiru. Sirni kun haqa kan hin qabneefi akkaataa rakkoolee addunyaa waraana Gazaafi Yukreen fa'i furuun hindanda'amne taasiseera jedhan. Haa ta'u malee, jijjiiramni akkanaa kun kan milkaa'u biyyoota murtii kana kennuuf mirga qaban hunda irratti waliigaltee yoo argate qofa waan ta'eef, dhugoomsuun isaa baay'ee ulfaataadha.

title: The media battle behind Brazil’s election
english: As Brazil approaches national elections, Flavio Bolsonaro is campaigning by distancing himself from his father's controversial image. The media narrative is currently heavily focused on a massive banking corruption scandal, leading many voters to perceive all politicians as equally dishonest. This coverage reflects how significant political and financial controversies influence public opinion during the election cycle.
amharic: ብራዚል ወደ ብሔራዊ ምርጫ ስትጠጋ፣ ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ ከአባታቸው አወዛጋቢ ስም ራሳቸውን በማራቅ የምርጫ ዘመቻ እያካሄዱ ነው። የሀገሪቱ የመገናኛ ብዙኃን በትልቁ የባንክ ሙስና ቅሌት ላይ ትኩረታቸውን በማድረጋቸው፣ ብዙ መራጮች ፖለቲከኞችን በሙሉ እንደ እኩል ሙሰኛ እንዲመለከቷቸው አድርጓቸዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ ትልቅ የፖለቲካ እና የገንዘብ አወዛጋቢ ጉዳዮች በምርጫ ወቅት የህዝብን አስተያየት እንዴት እንደሚቀርጹ ያሳያል።
oromo: Braziil gara filannoo biyyoolessaatti yommuu deemtu, Flavio Bolsonaro abbaa isaanii irraa adda of baasuun duula filannoo gaggeessaa jiru. Miidiyaaleen biyyattii hatattamaa yakka malaammaltummaa baankii gurguddaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun, namoonni baay'een siyaas-hawaasni hundi wal qixa akka malaammaltoota ta'anitti akka yaadan taasiiseera. Kunis dhimmoota siyaasaa fi dinagdee gurguddoon yeroo filannoo keessatti yaada ummataa akkamitti akka jijjiiran kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Bangkok roads submerged as flood disaster declared
english: Bangkok has declared a flood emergency across all 50 districts following two days of relentless heavy rainfall that overwhelmed the city's drainage systems. Many roads are currently underwater, and residents living near canals have been advised to move their belongings to higher ground as water levels continue to rise. While the city government is working to pump out the water, authorities have urged people to stay home as more rain is expected throughout the weekend.
amharic: ባንኮክ ለሁለት ቀናት በዘለቀው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት መላው ከተማዋን የሚያካልል የአደጋ ጊዜ አዋጅ አውጃለች። ጎርፉ የከተማዋን የፍሳሽ ማስወገጃዎች በመሙላቱ ብዙ መንገዶች በውሃ ተጥለቅልቀዋል። በቦዮች አቅራቢያ የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች ንብረቶቻቸውን ወደ ከፍታ ቦታ እንዲያንቀሳቅሱ የተመከሩ ሲሆን፣ ዝናቡ እንደሚቀጥል በመጠበቁ ባለሥልጣናት ህዝቡ በቤቱ እንዲቆይ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Magalaan Bangkok rooba cimaa guyyoota lamaaf itti fufeen wal qabatee labsiin hatattamaa balaa lolaa guutummaa naannolee ishee hunda keessatti labsiteetti. Biyyoonni bishaan gadi dhangalaasu guutamuu isaaniitiin daandiiwwan hedduun bishaan jalatti bulaniiru. Jiraattonni naannoo bo'oowwanii bishaan irra naannawaa jiran qabeenya isaanii gara bakka ol'aanaatti akka geessan gorfamaniiru; roobni dabalataan waan itti fufuufis mootummaan uummata mana keessatti akka turu gorseera.

title: Pro-Palestine Action group to rally at Labour conference led by Burnham
english: Protesters are planning a silent vigil in Liverpool during the Labour Party conference to challenge the government's decision to label Palestine Action as a terrorist group. Activists are calling on Prime Minister Andy Burnham to end the crackdown on peaceful supporters and halt UK arms sales to Israel. Organizers view this event as a critical test of the new leadership's commitment to justice regarding the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ደጋፊዎች በሊቨርፑል በሚካሄደው የሌበር ፓርቲ ጉባኤ ወቅት የፓለስታይን አክሽን ቡድን በአሸባሪነት መፈረጁን በመቃወም ዝምታ የሰፈነበት ሰልፍ ለማድረግ አቅደዋል። አክቲቪስቶች ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ሰላማዊ ተቃዋሚዎችን ማሰር እንዲያቆሙ እና ለእስራኤል የሚደረገውን የጦር መሳሪያ ሽያጭ እንዲሰርዙ እየጠየቁ ነው። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ይህንን ዝግጅት የአዲሱ አመራር ለፍትህ ያላቸውን አቋም የሚፈትሽ ወሳኝ ወቅት እንደሆነ ይገልጹታል።
oromo: Deeggartoonni Falasxiin, gareen 'Palestine Action' jedhamu akka garee shororkeessaatti ramadamuu isaa mormuuf, walgahii dhaabbata 'Labour Party' kan Liverpoolitti gaggeeffamu irratti hiriira calaqqee ta'e tokko geggeessuuf karoorfataniiru. Qabsaa'onni mirgaa, muummichi ministeeraa Andy Burnham tarkaanfii deeggartoota nagaa irratti fudhatamu akka dhaabanii fi meeshaalee waraanaa gara Israa'el ergu akka dhaaban gaafachaa jiru. Gurmeessitoonni hiriirichaa, tarkaanfiin kun qormaata guddaa hoggansi haaraan kun haqaaf qaban irratti ta'uu dubbataniiru.

title: Pochettino regrets limited role in Balogun red card decision at World Cup
english: US coach Mauricio Pochettino regrets not being more involved in the appeal process regarding Folarin Balogun's red card during the World Cup. The controversy, fueled by political intervention, negatively impacted the team's atmosphere before their subsequent loss to Belgium. Pochettino believes such sensitive disciplinary matters should be handled by a smaller internal group to avoid unwanted distractions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ብሔራዊ ቡድን አሰልጣኝ ማውሪሲዮ ፖቸቲኖ በፍላሪን ባሎጉን ላይ በተላለፈው የቀይ ካርድ ውሳኔ ይግባኝ ሂደት ውስጥ በበቂ ሁኔታ ባለመሳተፋቸው መጸጸታቸውን ገልጸዋል። በፖለቲካ ጣልቃ ገብነት የታጀበው ይህ አወዛጋቢ ክስተት በቡድኑ ስሜት ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ በማሳደሩ ከቤልጂየም ጋር ለነበረው ጨዋታ ዝግጅት እንቅፋት ሆኗል። አሰልጣኙ በቀጣይ እንዲህ አይነት ዲሲፕሊናዊ ጉዳዮች ከውጫዊ ተጽእኖ ነጻ በሆነ አነስተኛ የውስጥ ቡድን ብቻ መወሰን አለባቸው ብለዋል።
oromo: Leenjisaan garee biyyoolessa Ameerikaa Morisiiyo Poochetiinoo murtii kaardii diimaa Folaariin Baaloogun irratti darbe irratti komii dhiyeessuun walqabatee gahee gahaa hin taphatin hafuusaanii gaddaniiru. Waan siyaasaan walqabatee uumame kun haala garee sanaa irratti dhiibbaa waan godheef, tapha Beeljiyeem wajjin taphataniin dura jeeqamni uumameera. Poochetiinoon dhimmi akkanaa kun dhiibbaa alaa malee garee xiqqaa keessoo qofa ta'een murtaa'uu qaba jedhaniiru.

title: Iran war squeezes Iraq’s economy as oil revenues fall and prices rise
english: The ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran has severely damaged Iraq's economy by blocking key oil export routes in the Strait of Hormuz. Because Iraq relies on oil sales for almost its entire federal budget, losing these export capabilities has caused a massive revenue shortfall of approximately $60 billion. Furthermore, disrupted supply chains have led to significantly higher prices for imported essential goods, placing a heavy financial burden on Iraqi businesses and citizens.
amharic: በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በኩል የሚደረገውን የነዳጅ ንግድ በመስተጓጎሉ የኢራቅን ኢኮኖሚ በእጅጉ ጎድቷል። ኢራቅ ለፌዴራል በጀቷ በዋናነት በነዳጅ ሽያጭ ላይ የምትመረኮዝ በመሆኑ፣ የነዳጅ መላኪያ መንገዶች መዘጋት ወደ 60 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚጠጋ የገቢ ማጣት አስከትሏል። ከዚህም በላይ የአቅርቦት ሰንሰለቱ በመስተጓጎሉ ምክንያት በኢራቅ ገበያ የሚሸጡ ከውጭ የሚገቡ ሸቀጦች ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ደረጃ በመጨመሩ በዜጎችና በንግድ ተቋማት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Waraanni gidduu Ameerikaa, Israa'el fi Iraan jiru karaa balbala Hormuz cufuun diinagdee Iraaq miidhee jira. Iraaq bajata ishee kan guutuun isaa dhibbeentaa sagaltamii ol kan hirkatu gurgurtaa boba'aa irratti waan ta'eef, karaa boba'aa kanaan cufamuun isaa biyyattii doolaara biliyoona 60 akka dhabdu taasiseera. Dabalataanis, dhiyeessiin alaa gufachuun isaa gatiin meeshaalee biyya alaatii galanii akka dabalu taasiseera, kunis daldaltoota fi uummata Iraaq irratti ba'aa dinagdee guddaa fideera.

title: Disaster zone declared across Bangkok as heavy rain triggers flooding
english: Authorities have declared a disaster zone across all 50 districts of Bangkok following three days of relentless rainfall. The flooding has submerged major roads, damaged homes and businesses, and overwhelmed the city's drainage systems. Officials are actively pumping out water and have provided free parking on higher ground for residents to protect their vehicles as they wait for the floodwaters to recede.
amharic: ባንኮክ ውስጥ ለሶስት ተከታታይ ቀናት በጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት መላው የከተማዋ 50 ወረዳዎች የአደጋ ቀጠና ሆነው ታውጀዋል። ጎርፉ ዋና ዋና መንገዶችን በማጥለቅለቅ በበርካታ ቤቶችና የንግድ ተቋማት ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። የከተማዋ አስተዳደር የጎርፍ ውሃን ለማስወገድ ጥረት እያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎች መኪኖቻቸውን ከጎርፍ ለመታደግ እንዲችሉ ከፍ ባለ ቦታ ላይ በነጻ ማቆም እንዲችሉ አድርጓል።
oromo: Rooba guyyoota sadan darbanitti magaalaa Bangkoonkitti roobeen wal qabatee, aanaalee magaalaa sanaa hunda keessatti labsiin yeroo balaa labsameera. Lolidhaan daandiiwwan guguddoo, manneen jireenyaa fi bakkeewwan daldalaa hedduu kan miidhe yoo ta'u, sirni dhangala'aa bishaanii magaalaattis guutummaatti cufameera. Qondaalonni magaalaan bishaan dhangala'aa sana hir'isuuf hojjechaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, jiraattonni konkolaataa isaanii balaa loliidhaa oolchuuf iddoo olka'aatti tola akka dhaabbatan carraa mijeesseera.

title: Could AI firms be held responsible for mass shootings?
english: A new lawsuit filed by the Canadian province of British Columbia accuses OpenAI of failing to report violent threats made on ChatGPT prior to a tragic 2024 mass shooting. The legal action seeks compensation for recovery costs and demands that the company improve its safety protocols for identifying dangerous user behavior. This case, supported by dozens of other lawsuits from victims' families, highlights the growing debate over whether AI companies should be held legally responsible for how their technology is misused.
amharic: የካናዳዋ ብሪቲሽ ኮሎምቢያ ግዛት፣ በ2024 በቱምብለር ሪጅ ከተማ የደረሰውን አሰቃቂ የተኩስ አደጋ ከመፈጸሙ በፊት ChatGPT ላይ የተሰጡ የጥቃት ማስጠንቀቂያዎችን ሪፖርት ባለማድረጉ OpenAI ላይ ክስ መስርታለች። የክሱ ዓላማ የአደጋውን ተፅዕኖ ለመቋቋም የሚወጣውን ወጪ ማስከፈል እና ኩባንያው አደገኛ የተጠቃሚ ባህሪያትን ለመለየት ያለውን የደህንነት መመሪያ እንዲያሻሽል ማስገደድ ነው። ይህ ክስ እና ሌሎች ከተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች የቀረቡ ተያያዥ ክሶች፣ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች በምርቶቻቸው ለሚፈጠሩ ወንጀሎች ህጋዊ ተጠያቂነት ሊኖራቸው ይገባል ወይ የሚለውን አከራካሪ ጥያቄ አንስቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan naannoo British Columbia kan Kaanaadaa, OpenAI ergaa ChatGPT irratti darbe kan yakka doorsisu duraan beekuu dhabuu ykn gabaasuu dhabuun isaa ajjeechaa bara 2024 raawwatameef itti gaafatamuu qaba jechuun himateera. Himannaan kun baasii balaa sana booda jiru akka qophaauufi dhaabbatichi akkaataa itti fayyadamtoota balaa geessisan adda baafatu irratti fooyya'iinsa akka godhu gaafata. Himannaan kun fi kanneen maatii miidhamtootaan dhiyaatan biroo, guddinni teeknoolojii AI fi itti gaafatamummaan dhaabbilee kanaa maallaqa fi seeraan walqabatee gaaffii uumameera.

title: The Error in Tsmido’s Trial and Error
english: Various Ethiopian opposition groups, including the TPLF, Fano, and OLA, are forming a fragile alliance under the name Tsmido, united solely by their goal to weaken Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government. Despite this shared objective, these groups hold deep ideological disagreements regarding national identity and territorial control that could cause the coalition to collapse. This tactical cooperation carries extreme risks, as the potential failure of the experiment could lead to state fragmentation and renewed internal conflict.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ተቃዋሚ ኃይሎች የሆኑት ህወሓት፣ ፋኖ እና ኦነግ-ሸኔ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አቢይ አህመድን ለማዳከም 'ትስሚዶ' በሚል ስያሜ አዲስ ጥምረት እየፈጠሩ ነው። እነዚህ ቡድኖች በስልጣን ላይ ያለውን መንግስት ለመቃወም ቢስማሙም፣ ስለ ሀገር አወቃቀር እና ስለወደፊቷ ኢትዮጵያ ያላቸው መሰረታዊ ልዩነት ጥምረቱን አደጋ ላይ ይጥለዋል። ይህ ስልታዊ ትብብር ሀገሪቱን ወደ ውድቀት እና ወደ ውስብስብ የእርስ በእርስ ግጭት ሊወስድ የሚችል ከፍተኛ ስጋት አለው።
oromo: ጉruppen mormituu Itoophiyaa kan akka TPLF, Fano fi WBO, muummee ministiraa Abiy Ahmed dadhabsiisuuf 'Tsmido' maqaa jedhuun gamtaa laafaa tokko uumachaa jiru. Gareewwan kunneen mootummaa amma jiru mormuuf walii galan iyyuu, waa'ee caasaa biyyattii fi gara fuulduraa irratti yaada adda addaa waan qabaniif gamtaan kun diigamuu danda'a. Hojiin kun tarkaanfii yaalii fi dogoggoraa waan ta'eef, yoo milkaa'uu baate biyyattiin gara badii fi walitti bu'iinsa haaraatti akka geessu sodaatama.

title: #ትሰማ Unmasks a Power Struggle Over Culture in Ethiopia
english: The Ethiopian #ትሰማ (Let Her Be Heard) campaign is highlighting systemic failures in addressing violence against women and girls. While activists demand government accountability and institutional reforms to tackle this national crisis, critics express concern that the movement reflects an external cultural influence. Ultimately, the campaign has sparked a complex national debate regarding justice, social tradition, and the evolving role of women in Ethiopian society.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ #ትሰማ ዘመቻ በሴቶች እና በህጻናት ላይ የሚፈጸመውን ጥቃት ለመከላከል የመንግስት ተጠያቂነትና የፍትህ ስርዓት ማሻሻያ እንዲደረግ እየጠየቀ ይገኛል። ይሁን እንጂ አንዳንድ ወገኖች ይህ እንቅስቃሴ ከውጭ የመጣ ባህልን የማስፋፋት አዝማሚያ አለው የሚል ስጋት አላቸው። በዚህም ምክንያት ዘመቻው በፍትህ፣ በባህል እና በሴቶች መብት ላይ ሰፊ ሀገራዊ ክርክር አስነስቷል።
oromo: Duula #Tessamaa (Akka Isheen Dhageeffatamtu) jedhu Itoophiyaa keessatti miidhaa dubartootaa fi shamarran irratti raawwatamu ittisuuf mootummaan itti gaafatamummaa akka fudhatuu fi sirni haqaa akka fooyya'u gaafachaa jira. Haa ta'u malee, qaamoleen tokko tokko duulli kun aadaa alaa galchuuf yaala jechuun yaaddoo ibsaa jiru. Dhimmi kun nageenya, aadaa fi mirga dubartootaa irratti wal-falmii biyyaalessaa bal'aa uumee jira.

title: The bombs are still falling. Does diplomacy even work?
english: Global leaders are currently meeting at the United Nations to seek peaceful resolutions to ongoing international conflicts. However, experts are questioning the true effectiveness of these diplomatic efforts while active military strikes continue around the world. The discussion highlights the difficult challenge of pursuing peace negotiations during times of intense warfare.
amharic: የዓለም መሪዎች በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እየተካሄዱ ያሉ ግጭቶችን በሰላማዊ መንገድ ለመፍታት በተባበሩት መንግሥታት ድርጅት እየተወያዩ ይገኛሉ። ይሁን እንጂ፣ በአሁኑ ሰዓት ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች እየተፈጸሙ ባለበት ሁኔታ የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶች ምን ያህል ውጤታማ ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ባለሙያዎች ጥያቄ እያነሱ ነው። ይህ ውይይት ጦርነት ባለበት ወቅት ሰላም ለማምጣት የሚደረጉ ንግግሮች ምን ያህል ውስብስብ እንደሆኑ ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni biyyoolessaa waldhabdee addunyaa irratti mul'atu furuuf dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti mari'achaa jiru. Ta'us, waraanni fi haleellaan waraanaa utuu itti fufaa jiruu carraaqqiin diippilomaasii kun bu'aa qabaachuu isaa irratti ogeeyyonni shakkii qabu. Mariin kun yeroo waraanaa keessatti nagaa buusuun hammam rakkisaa akka ta'e kan ibsuudha.

title: Yemeni leader urges public to enlist, offers amnesty to Houthi defectors
english: Rashad al-Alimi, the leader of Yemen's governing council, has called for a national mobilization to join government forces following recent territorial losses to Houthi rebels. In his address, he announced that Houthi fighters who choose to defect will be granted a formal amnesty. The government remains focused on reclaiming control of the capital, Sana’a, while facing continued Houthi military pressure and missile attacks on regional neighbors.
amharic: የየመን የአስተዳደር ምክር ቤት መሪ ራሻድ አል-አሊሚ፣ በቅርቡ ሁቲዎች ካስመዘገቡት ወታደራዊ ድል በኋላ ህዝቡ በመንግስት ሰራዊት ውስጥ እንዲሰለፍ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በንግግራቸውም ከሁቲዎች የሚለዩ አማጺያን ይቅርታ እንደሚደረግላቸው አሳውቀዋል። መንግስት የሀገሪቱን ዋና ከተማ ሰንዓን መልሶ ለመቆጣጠር ያለውን ቁርጠኝነት የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ በሁቲዎች እየደረሰ ያለውን ወታደራዊ ጫና ለመመከት እየሰሩ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantuun bulchiinsa Yaman, Rashad al-Alimi, gareen Houthii lafa baay'ee to'achuu isaanii hordofee ummanni waraana mootummaatti akka makamu waamicha dhiyeessan. Ibsa isaanii keessatti, namoonni garee Houthii keessaa baqatanii gara mootummaatti dhufan hundi dhiifama akka argatan himaniiru. Mootummaan magaalattii Sana'a deebisanii to'achuuf kan karoorfate yoo ta'u, dhiibbaa waraana Houthii fi weerara misilaa naannawaa sana irratti gaggeeffamu dhaabuuf xiyyeeffannoo kennaa jira.

title: UNGA81: Why has Africa’s Security Council reform push remained unresolved?
english: African nations are once again demanding permanent representation and veto powers on the UN Security Council at the 81st General Assembly. Leaders argue that the current structure, unchanged since 1945, fails to reflect modern global realities despite the fact that a large portion of the Council's work involves African issues. However, achieving this reform is difficult because the existing permanent members are reluctant to give up their exclusive influence and control.
amharic: የአፍሪካ ሀገራት በ81ኛው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ በፀጥታው ምክር ቤት ውስጥ ቋሚ መቀመጫ እና የቬቶ መብት እንዲኖራቸው ጥሪያቸውን አድሰዋል። ምንም እንኳን የፀጥታው ምክር ቤት የሚወስናቸው አብዛኛዎቹ ውሳኔዎች ከአፍሪካ ጋር የተያያዙ ቢሆኑም፣ አሁን ያለው አወቃቀር ከ1945 ጀምሮ ሳይቀየር መቆየቱን መሪዎቹ ይተቻሉ። ይሁን እንጂ አሁን ያሉት ቋሚ አባላት ያላቸውን ልዩ ስልጣን ለመልቀቅ ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆናቸው ይህንን ለውጥ ማምጣት አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል።
oromo: Biyyoonni Afrikaa walga'ii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa 81ffaa irratti mana maree nageenyaa keessatti bakka dhaabbataa fi mirga veto akka argatan gaaffii isaanii dhiyeessaniiru. Hoggantoonni akka jedhanitti, seenaa 1945 irraa kaasee caasaan mana marichaa waan hin jijjiiramneef, haala yeroo ammaa waliin kan hin deemne ta'uu ibsu. Hojii mana marichaa keessatti dhimmi Afrikaa bakka olaanaa kan qabu ta'us, miseensonni dhaabbataan aangoosaanii gadi lakkisuuf waan hin barbaanneef jijjiirama kana dhugoomsuun rakkoo ta'ee jira.

title: Pope Leo XIV makes first official Papal visit in France in nearly 20
english: Pope Leo XIV recently concluded a historic trip to France, marking the first official papal visit to the country in nearly two decades. During his stay, the Pope held a large mass at the Stade de France, where he addressed and inspired thousands of young attendees. The event attracted massive crowds and served as a significant moment for the Catholic community in the region.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በፈረንሳይ ባደረጉት ታሪካዊ ጉብኝት ባለፉት ሃያ ዓመታት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ አገሪቱ የተጓዙ ጳጳስ ሆነዋል። በጉብኝታቸው ወቅት በስታድ ደ ፈረንሳይ በተዘጋጀው የጅምላ ጸሎት ሥነ-ሥርዓት ላይ በመገኘት ለሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ወጣቶችን አበረታተዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት እጅግ ብዙ ህዝብን የሳበ ሲሆን በአካባቢው ላሉ ካቶሊካውያን ትልቅ ትርጉም ያለው ነበር።
oromo: Papa Leo XIV yeroo jalqabaaf waggoota digdamanii as Firaansi kan daawwatan yoo ta'u, kunis daawwannaa seenaa qabeessa ture. Papaan kun magaalaa Paaris, dirree istaadiyeemii Stade de France keessatti guyyaa ayyaana qulqulluu qopheessuun dargaggoota kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman dubbisuun jajjabeessaniiru. Sagantaan kun namoota hedduu kan walitti qabe yoo ta'u, hawaasa Kaatolikii biyyattii biratti fudhatama guddaa argateera.

title: TikTok to pay $100 million to Alabama in teen addiction settlement
english: TikTok has reached a legal settlement worth at least $100 million with the state of Alabama. The deal was finalized shortly before the start of a trial regarding claims that the platform contributes to teenage social media addiction. This agreement highlights the growing legal pressure social media companies face concerning their impact on younger users.
amharic: ቲክቶክ በአላባማ ግዛት ለቀረበበት ክስ ቢያንስ 100 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ለመክፈል ተስማምቷል። ስምምነቱ የተደረሰው ማህበራዊ ሚዲያው በታዳጊዎች ላይ የሱስ ተፅእኖ አለው በሚል ክርክር ሊጀመር ጥቂት ቀናት ሲቀሩት ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ኩባንያዎች በወጣቶች ላይ ስላላቸው ተፅእኖ እየገጠማቸው ያለውን የህግ ጫና የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: TikTok mootummaa naannoo Alabama waliin kaffaltii yoo xiqqaate $100 miliyoonaa ta'u irratti walii galeera. Walii galteen kun kan raawwatame, dhiibbaan miidiyaaleen hawaasaa ijoollee irratti uuman qorannoo seeraa jalqabamuuf guyyoota muraasa qofatu hafee ture. Murteen kun dhaabbileen miidiyaa hawaasaa dhiibbaa dargaggoota irratti geessisaniin walqabatee rakkoo seeraa cimaa keessa akka jiran kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Pezeshkian says Iran will allow UN nuclear inspectors to return
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has indicated that his government is open to allowing UN nuclear inspectors back into the country as part of future negotiations. He emphasized that Iran has no intention of creating nuclear weapons, stating that such actions are religiously prohibited. This move signals a potential willingness to cooperate with international oversight to address ongoing concerns.
amharic: የኢራኑ ፕሬዚዳንት መስኡድ ፔዘሽኪያን መንግስታቸው ለወደፊት ድርድሮች አካል እንደመሆኑ መጠን የተባበሩት መንግስታት የኑክሌር ተቆጣጣሪዎች ወደ ሀገሪቱ እንዲመለሱ ለመፍቀድ ዝግጁ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ኢራን የኑክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ የመገንባት እቅድ እንደሌላት ያስታወቁት ፕሬዚዳንቱ፣ እንዲህ አይነት ድርጊቶች በሃይማኖት የተከለከሉ መሆናቸውን አስረድተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ሀገሪቱ ከዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት ጋር ለመተባበር ያላትን ፍላጎት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeshkiyaan mootummaan isaanii marii gara fuulduraa irratti hunda’uun qorattoonni niwukilaaraa kan Tokkummaa Mootummootaa biyyatti akka deebi’an heyyamuu akka danda’an ibsaniiru. Iraan meeshaa waraana niwukilaaraa oomishuuf akka hin karreefanne kan dubbatan pirezidaantichi, gochi akkasii amantiin dhorkaa ta’uu himaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattiin bulchiinsa idil-addunyaa waliin waliigaluuf fedhii akka qabdu kan agarsiisuudha.
